 190_proxy_index = 0

 193def get_next_proxy() -> str | None:
 194    """Return the next proxy from ``Config.PROXIES`` cycling sequentially."""
 195    global _proxy_index
 196    if not Config.PROXIES:
 197        return None
 198    proxy = Config.PROXIES[_proxy_index % len(Config.PROXIES)]
 199    _proxy_index += 1
 200    return proxy

 214class RateLimiter:
 215    """Simple exponential backoff rate limiter with jitter."""
 216
 217    def __init__(self, min_delay: float, max_delay: float | None = None):
 218        if max_delay is None:
 219            max_delay = min_delay
 220        self.base_min = min_delay
 221        self.base_max = max_delay
 222        self.min_delay = min_delay
 223        self.max_delay = max_delay
 224        self.consecutive_failures = 0
 225
 226    def _sample_delay(self) -> float:
 227        return random.uniform(self.min_delay, self.max_delay)
 228
 229    def wait(self):
 230        time.sleep(self._sample_delay())
 231
 232    async def async_wait(self):
 233        await asyncio.sleep(self._sample_delay())
 234
 235    def record_error(self):
 236        self.consecutive_failures += 1
 237        self.min_delay *= 2
 238        self.max_delay *= 2
 239
 240    def record_success(self):
 241        self.reset()
 242
 243    def reset(self):
 244        self.consecutive_failures = 0
 245        self.min_delay = self.base_min
 246        self.max_delay = self.base_max

 251# ============================
 252
 253# Mapas de alias para nomes canônicos de categorias. As chaves devem estar
 254# normalizadas (sem acentos e em minúsculas) para facilitar a busca.
 255CATEGORY_ALIASES = {
 256    "programacao": "Programação",
 257}
 258
 259
 260def normalize_category(name: str) -> Optional[str]:
 261    """Retorna o nome canônico de uma categoria.
 262
 263    A comparação ignora acentos e diferenças de maiúsculas/minúsculas.
 264    Se a categoria ou um de seus aliases for encontrado, devolve o nome
 265    oficial; caso contrário, ``None``.
 266    """
 267
 268    normalized = unidecode(name).lower()
 269
 270    for canonical in Config.CATEGORIES:
 271        if unidecode(canonical).lower() == normalized:
 272            return canonical
 273
 274    return CATEGORY_ALIASES.get(normalized)

 280class CustomFormatter(logging.Formatter):
 281    grey = "\x1b[38;20m"
 282    yellow = "\x1b[33;20m"
 283    red = "\x1b[31;20m"
 284    bold_red = "\x1b[31;1m"
 285    reset = "\x1b[0m"
 286    format_str = (
 287        "%(asctime)s - %(name)s - %(levelname)s - %(message)s (%(filename)s:%(lineno)d)"
 288    )
 289
 290    FORMATS = {
 291        logging.DEBUG: grey + format_str + reset,
 292        logging.INFO: grey + format_str + reset,
 293        logging.WARNING: yellow + format_str + reset,
 294        logging.ERROR: red + format_str + reset,
 295        logging.CRITICAL: bold_red + format_str + reset,
 296    }
 297
 298    def format(self, record):
 299        log_fmt = self.FORMATS.get(record.levelno)
 300        formatter = logging.Formatter(log_fmt)
 301        return formatter.format(record)

 304class JsonFormatter(logging.Formatter):
 305    """Simple JSON formatter with standard fields."""
 306
 307    def format(self, record: logging.LogRecord) -> str:
 308        rec = {
 309            "timestamp": self.formatTime(record, self.datefmt),
 310            "level": record.levelname,
 311            "name": record.name,
 312            "message": record.getMessage(),
 313            "file": record.filename,
 314            "line": record.lineno,
 315        }
 316        return json.dumps(rec, ensure_ascii=False)

 319class LokiHandler(logging.Handler):
 320    """Simple handler that sends logs to a Loki HTTP endpoint."""
 321
 322    def __init__(self, url: str):
 323        super().__init__()
 324        self.url = url.rstrip("/")
 325
 326    def emit(self, record: logging.LogRecord) -> None:
 327        try:
 328            line = self.format(record)
 329            payload = {
 330                "streams": [
 331                    {
 332                        "labels": '{job="scraper"}',
 333                        "entries": [
 334                            {
 335                                "ts": datetime.utcnow().isoformat() + "Z",
 336                                "line": line,
 337                            }
 338                        ],
 339                    }
 340                ]
 341            }
 342            requests.post(self.url, json=payload, timeout=1)
 343        except Exception:
 344            pass

 347class ElasticsearchHandler(logging.Handler):
 348    """Send logs to an Elasticsearch index."""
 349
 350    def __init__(self, url: str, index: str = "scraper"):
 351        super().__init__()
 352        self.url = url.rstrip("/")
 353        self.index = index
 354
 355    def emit(self, record: logging.LogRecord) -> None:
 356        try:
 357            doc = {
 358                "timestamp": datetime.utcnow().isoformat(),
 359                "level": record.levelname,
 360                "name": record.name,
 361                "message": record.getMessage(),
 362                "file": record.filename,
 363                "line": record.lineno,
 364            }
 365            requests.post(f"{self.url}/{self.index}/_doc", json=doc, timeout=1)
 366        except Exception:
 367            pass

 370def setup_logger(name, log_file, level: int = logging.INFO, fmt: str = "text"):
 371    """Configure and return a logger with console and file handlers."""
 372    os.makedirs(Config.LOG_DIR, exist_ok=True)
 373
 374    logger = logging.getLogger(name)
 375    logger.setLevel(level)
 376    logger.handlers.clear()
 377
 378    formatter = JsonFormatter() if fmt == "json" else CustomFormatter()
 379
 380    handler = logging.FileHandler(os.path.join(Config.LOG_DIR, log_file))
 381    handler.setFormatter(formatter)
 382    logger.addHandler(handler)
 383
 384    console_handler = logging.StreamHandler()
 385    console_handler.setFormatter(formatter)
 386    logger.addHandler(console_handler)
 387
 388    if Config.LOG_SERVICE_URL:
 389        if Config.LOG_SERVICE_TYPE == "elastic":
 390            remote = ElasticsearchHandler(Config.LOG_SERVICE_URL)
 391        else:
 392            remote = LokiHandler(Config.LOG_SERVICE_URL)
 393        remote.setFormatter(formatter)
 394        logger.addHandler(remote)
 395
 396    return logger
 397

 417class CacheBackend(Protocol):
 418    def get(self, key: str): ...
 419
 420    def set(self, key: str, data, ttl: Optional[int] = None): ...
 421
 422    def stats(self) -> dict: ...
 423
 424
 425class FileCache(CacheBackend):
 426    def __init__(self):
 427        os.makedirs(Config.CACHE_DIR, exist_ok=True)
 428        self.hits = 0
 429        self.misses = 0
 430
 431    def _get_cache_path(self, key: str) -> str:
 432        hash_key = hashlib.md5(key.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
 433        return os.path.join(Config.CACHE_DIR, f"{hash_key}.pkl.gz")
 434
 435    @backoff.on_exception(backoff.expo, Exception, max_tries=3)
 436    def get(self, key: str):
 437        cache_file = self._get_cache_path(key)
 438        if os.path.exists(cache_file):
 439            try:
 440                with open(cache_file, "rb") as f:
 441                    compressed_data = f.read()
 442                data = pickle.loads(zlib.decompress(compressed_data))
 443                self.hits += 1
 444                return data
 445            except Exception as e:
 446                logger.warning(f"Erro ao ler cache {key}: {e}")
 447                os.remove(cache_file)
 448
 449        self.misses += 1
 450        return None
 451
 452    @backoff.on_exception(backoff.expo, Exception, max_tries=3)
 453    def set(self, key: str, data, ttl: Optional[int] = None):
 454        cache_file = self._get_cache_path(key)
 455        try:
 456            compressed_data = zlib.compress(pickle.dumps(data))
 457            temp_file = cache_file + ".tmp"
 458            with open(temp_file, "wb") as f:
 459                f.write(compressed_data)
 460            os.replace(temp_file, cache_file)
 461        except Exception as e:
 462            logger.error(f"Erro ao salvar cache {key}: {e}")
 463            if os.path.exists(temp_file):
 464                os.remove(temp_file)
 465
 466    def stats(self) -> dict:
 467        return {
 468            "hits": self.hits,
 469            "misses": self.misses,
 470            "hit_rate": (
 471                self.hits / (self.hits + self.misses)
 472                if (self.hits + self.misses) > 0
 473                else 0
 474            ),
 475        }
 476
 477
 478class RedisCache(CacheBackend):
 479    def __init__(self, url: str):
 480        try:
 481            import redis  # type: ignore
 482        except Exception as exc:  # pragma: no cover - import error
 483            raise ImportError("redis package required for RedisCache") from exc
 484
 485        self.client = redis.Redis.from_url(url)
 486        self.hits = 0
 487        self.misses = 0
 488
 489    def get(self, key: str):
 490        val = self.client.get(key)
 491        if val is not None:
 492            try:
 493                data = pickle.loads(zlib.decompress(val))
 494            except Exception:
 495                self.client.delete(key)
 496                self.misses += 1
 497                return None
 498            self.hits += 1
 499            return data
 500        self.misses += 1
 501        return None
 502
 503    def set(self, key: str, data, ttl: Optional[int] = None):
 504        val = zlib.compress(pickle.dumps(data))
 505        if ttl:
 506            self.client.setex(key, ttl, val)
 507        else:
 508            self.client.set(key, val)
 509
 510    def stats(self) -> dict:
 511        return {
 512            "hits": self.hits,
 513            "misses": self.misses,
 514            "hit_rate": (
 515                self.hits / (self.hits + self.misses)
 516                if (self.hits + self.misses) > 0
 517                else 0
 518            ),
 519        }
 520
 521
 522class SQLiteCache(CacheBackend):
 523    def __init__(self, path: str):
 524        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)
 525        self.conn = sqlite3.connect(path, check_same_thread=False)
 526        self.conn.execute(
 527            "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cache (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value BLOB, expires_at INTEGER)"
 528        )
 529        self.hits = 0
 530        self.misses = 0
 531
 532    def get(self, key: str):
 533        cur = self.conn.execute(
 534            "SELECT value, expires_at FROM cache WHERE key=?", (key,)
 535        )
 536        row = cur.fetchone()
 537        if row:
 538            value, exp = row
 539            if exp is not None and exp < int(time.time()):
 540                self.conn.execute("DELETE FROM cache WHERE key=?", (key,))
 541                self.conn.commit()
 542                self.misses += 1
 543                return None
 544            try:
 545                data = pickle.loads(zlib.decompress(value))
 546            except Exception:
 547                self.conn.execute("DELETE FROM cache WHERE key=?", (key,))
 548                self.conn.commit()
 549                self.misses += 1
 550                return None
 551            self.hits += 1
 552            return data
 553        self.misses += 1
 554        return None
 555
 556    def set(self, key: str, data, ttl: Optional[int] = None):
 557        val = zlib.compress(pickle.dumps(data))
 558        exp = int(time.time()) + ttl if ttl else None
 559        self.conn.execute(
 560            "REPLACE INTO cache (key, value, expires_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
 561            (key, val, exp),
 562        )
 563        self.conn.commit()
 564
 565    def stats(self) -> dict:
 566        return {
 567            "hits": self.hits,
 568            "misses": self.misses,
 569            "hit_rate": (
 570                self.hits / (self.hits + self.misses)
 571                if (self.hits + self.misses) > 0
 572                else 0
 573            ),
 574        }
 575
 576
 577def init_cache() -> CacheBackend:
 578    if Config.CACHE_BACKEND == "redis":
 579        return RedisCache(Config.REDIS_URL)
 580    if Config.CACHE_BACKEND == "sqlite":
 581        return SQLiteCache(Config.SQLITE_PATH)
 582    return FileCache()
 583
 584
 585cache: CacheBackend = init_cache()
 586
 587
 588def clear_cache() -> None:
 589    """Remove arquivos ou registros expirados do cache."""
 590    ttl = Config.CACHE_TTL
 591    if Config.CACHE_BACKEND == "sqlite":
 592        if not os.path.exists(Config.SQLITE_PATH):
 593            return
 594        conn = sqlite3.connect(Config.SQLITE_PATH)
 595        conn.execute(
 596            "DELETE FROM cache WHERE expires_at IS NOT NULL AND expires_at < ?",
 597            (int(time.time()),),
 598        )
 599        conn.commit()
 600        conn.close()
 601    elif Config.CACHE_BACKEND == "file":
 602        if ttl is None:
 603            return
 604        cutoff = time.time() - ttl
 605        path = Path(Config.CACHE_DIR)
 606        if path.exists():
 607            for p in path.glob("*.pkl.gz"):
 608                if p.stat().st_mtime < cutoff:
 609                    p.unlink()
 610    else:
 611        # Redis remove chaves expiradas automaticamente
 612        pass

 624class NLPProcessor:
 625    _instances = {}
 626
 627    @classmethod
 628    def get_instance(cls, lang: str):
 629        if lang not in cls._instances:
 630            if lang in Config.NLP_MODELS:
 631                try:
 632                    cls._instances[lang] = spacy.load(Config.NLP_MODELS[lang])
 633                    logger.info(f"Carregado modelo NLP para {lang}")
 634                except OSError:
 635                    logger.warning(
 636                        f"Modelo NLP para {lang} não encontrado, tentando modelo pequeno"
 637                    )
 638                    try:
 639                        cls._instances[lang] = spacy.load(
 640                            Config.NLP_MODELS[lang].replace("_lg", "_sm")
 641                        )
 642                    except OSError:
 643                        logger.warning(
 644                            f"Modelos lg e sm para {lang} indisponíveis, usando 'en_core_web_sm'"
 645                        )
 646                        cls._instances[lang] = spacy.load("en_core_web_sm")
 647            else:
 648                logger.warning(f"Modelo NLP para {lang} não configurado, usando inglês")
 649                cls._instances[lang] = spacy.load(Config.NLP_MODELS["en"])
 650        return cls._instances[lang]
 651
 652    @classmethod
 653    def get_embedding_model(cls):
 654        if not hasattr(cls, "_embedding_model"):
 655            cls._embedding_model = SentenceTransformer(Config.EMBEDDING_MODEL)
 656        return cls._embedding_model
 657

 659def extract_keywords(text: str, lang: str = "en", n: int = 10) -> List[str]:
 660    try:
 661        nlp = NLPProcessor.get_instance(lang)
 662        doc = nlp(text)
 663
 664        # Filtra substantivos e nomes próprios
 665        keywords = [
 666            chunk.text for chunk in doc.noun_chunks if len(chunk.text.split()) <= 3
 667        ]
 668
 669        # Remove duplicatas e conta frequência
 670        freq = {}
 671        for word in keywords:
 672            word_lower = word.lower()
 673            if word_lower in freq:
 674                freq[word_lower] += 1
 675            else:
 676                freq[word_lower] = 1
 677
 678        # Ordena por frequência e pega os top N
 679        sorted_keywords = sorted(freq.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)
 680        return [kw[0] for kw in sorted_keywords[:n]]
 681
 682    except Exception as e:
 683        logger.error(f"Erro ao extrair keywords: {e}")
 684        return []

 687def summarize_text(text: str, lang: str = "en") -> str:
 688    try:
 689        parser = PlaintextParser.from_string(text, Tokenizer(lang))
 690        summarizer = LsaSummarizer()
 691        summary = summarizer(parser.document, Config.SUMMARY_SENTENCES)
 692        return " ".join([str(sentence) for sentence in summary])
 693    except Exception as e:
 694        logger.error(f"Erro ao sumarizar texto: {e}")
 695        return (
 696            text[: Config.MIN_TEXT_LENGTH]
 697            if len(text) > Config.MIN_TEXT_LENGTH
 698            else text
 699        )

 702def cluster_texts(texts: List[str], k: int = Config.CLUSTER_K) -> np.ndarray:
 703    try:
 704        model = NLPProcessor.get_embedding_model()
 705        embeddings = model.encode(texts, show_progress_bar=False)
 706
 707        # Normaliza os embeddings
 708        norms = np.linalg.norm(embeddings, axis=1, keepdims=True)
 709        normalized_embeddings = embeddings / norms
 710
 711        # Clusteriza usando K-means
 712        kmeans = KMeans(n_clusters=k, random_state=42)
 713        clusters = kmeans.fit_predict(normalized_embeddings)
 714
 715        return clusters
 716    except Exception as e:
 717        logger.error(f"Erro no clustering: {e}")
 718        return np.zeros(len(texts))

 724def advanced_clean_text(
 725    text: str,
 726    lang: str = "en",
 727    remove_stopwords: bool = False,
 728    split: bool = False,
 729    stem: bool = False,
 730) -> str | list[str]:
 731    """Clean wiki text with optional stopword removal, stemming and sentence splitting."""
 732    try:
 733        text = clean_wiki_text(text)
 734
 735        # Remove caracteres especiais, mantendo acentos quando relevante
 736        if lang in ["en", "de"]:
 737            text = unidecode(text)
 738
 739        # Remove padrões específicos da Wikipedia
 740        text = re.sub(r"\[\d+\]", "", text)  # Referências [1], [2], etc.
 741        text = re.sub(
 742            r"\b(ver também|see also|véase también|voir aussi)\b.*",
 743            "",
 744            text,
 745            flags=re.IGNORECASE,
 746        )
 747        text = re.sub(r"\{\|.*?\|\}", "", text, flags=re.DOTALL)  # Remove tables
 748
 749        # Remove seções específicas
 750        sections_to_remove = [
 751            "referências",
 752            "references",
 753            "referencias",
 754            "bibliografia",
 755            "bibliography",
 756            "bibliografía",
 757            "ligações externas",
 758            "external links",
 759            "enlaces externos",
 760        ]
 761        for section in sections_to_remove:
 762            text = re.sub(
 763                rf"==\s*{section}\s*==.*", "", text, flags=re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL
 764            )
 765
 766        if remove_stopwords or stem:
 767            removed = False
 768            try:
 769                nlp = NLPProcessor.get_instance(lang)
 770                doc = nlp(text)
 771                tokens = []
 772                for t in doc:
 773                    if remove_stopwords and getattr(t, "is_stop", False):
 774                        continue
 775                    tokens.append(t.lemma_ if stem else t.text)
 776                text = " ".join(tokens)
 777                removed = True
 778            except Exception as e:
 779                logger.error(f"Erro ao processar texto com spaCy: {e}")
 780            if not removed:
 781                try:
 782                    import nltk
 783                    from nltk.corpus import stopwords
 784                    from nltk.stem import SnowballStemmer, PorterStemmer
 785
 786                    stop_words = set()
 787                    if remove_stopwords:
 788                        stop_words = set(stopwords.words(lang))
 789                    if stem:
 790                        try:
 791                            stemmer = SnowballStemmer(lang)
 792                        except Exception:
 793                            stemmer = PorterStemmer()
 794                    tokens = []
 795                    for w in text.split():
 796                        if remove_stopwords and w.lower() in stop_words:
 797                            continue
 798                        if stem:
 799                            tokens.append(stemmer.stem(w))
 800                        else:
 801                            tokens.append(w)
 802                    text = " ".join(tokens)
 803                except Exception as e:
 804                    logger.error(f"Erro ao processar texto com NLTK: {e}")
 805
 806        text = text.strip()
 807        if split:
 808            return split_sentences(text, lang)
 809        return text
 810    except Exception as e:
 811        logger.error(f"Erro na limpeza de texto: {e}")
 812        return text

 815def extract_main_content(page_html: str) -> str:
 816    try:
 817        soup = BeautifulSoup(page_html, "html.parser")
 818
 819        # Remove elementos indesejados
 820        for element in soup.find_all(
 821            [
 822                "table",
 823                "div.infobox",
 824                "span.reference",
 825                "ol.references",
 826                "div.navbox",
 827                "div.hatnote",
 828                "div.thumb",
 829                "div.notice",
 830            ]
 831        ):
 832            element.decompose()
 833
 834        # Extrai conteúdo principal
 835        content_div = soup.find("div", {"id": "mw-content-text"})
 836        if content_div:
 837            return str(content_div)
 838        return page_html
 839    except Exception as e:
 840        logger.error(f"Erro ao extrair conteúdo principal: {e}")
 841        return page_html

 859def extract_infobox(html: str) -> Dict[str, str]:
 860    """Return a dictionary with key/value pairs from the first infobox table."""
 861    try:
 862        soup = BeautifulSoup(html, "html.parser")
 863        box = soup.find("table", class_=lambda c: c and "infobox" in c)
 864        if not box:
 865            return {}
 866        data: Dict[str, str] = {}
 867        for row in box.find_all("tr"):
 868            header = row.find("th")
 869            value = row.find("td")
 870            if header and value:
 871                key = header.get_text(strip=True)
 872                val = value.get_text(strip=True)
 873                data[key] = val
 874        return data
 875    except Exception as e:
 876        logger.error(f"Erro ao extrair infobox: {e}")
 877        return {}

 880def extract_tables(html: str) -> List[List[List[str]]]:
 881    """Return all HTML tables as lists of rows and cells."""

 899def extract_images(html: str) -> List[Dict[str, str]]:
 900    """Return image URLs and captions from thumbnail/figure elements."""
 901    try:
 902        soup = BeautifulSoup(html, "html.parser")
 903        results: List[Dict[str, str]] = []
 904
 905        for div in soup.find_all("div", class_=lambda c: c and "thumb" in c.split()):
 906            img = div.find("img")
 907            if not img or not img.get("src"):
 908                continue
 909            url = img["src"]
 910            if url.startswith("//"):
 911                url = "https:" + url
 912            caption_tag = div.find(class_="thumbcaption")
 913            caption = caption_tag.get_text(strip=True) if caption_tag else ""
 914            results.append({"image_url": url, "caption": caption})
 915
 916        for fig in soup.find_all("figure"):
 917            img = fig.find("img")
 918            if not img or not img.get("src"):
 919                continue
 920            url = img["src"]
 921            if url.startswith("//"):
 922                url = "https:" + url
 923            caption_tag = fig.find("figcaption")
 924            caption = caption_tag.get_text(strip=True) if caption_tag else ""
 925            results.append({"image_url": url, "caption": caption})
 926
 927        return results
 928    except Exception as e:
 929        logger.error(f"Erro ao extrair imagens: {e}")
 930        return []

 933async def fetch_with_retry(
 934    url: str,
 935    *,
 936    params: dict | None = None,
 937    headers: dict | None = None,
 938    retries: int = Config.RETRIES,
 939    proxy: str | None = None,
 940) -> tuple[int, str]:
 941    """Fetch a URL using ``aiohttp`` with automatic retries and logging."""
 942
 943    if proxy is None and Config.PROXIES:
 944        proxy = get_next_proxy()
 945
 946    for attempt in range(1, retries + 1):
 947        try:
 948            timeout = aiohttp.ClientTimeout(total=Config.TIMEOUT)
 949            acquired_dummy = False
 950            if (
 951                hasattr(fetch_semaphore, "active")
 952                and hasattr(fetch_semaphore, "limit")
 953                and not hasattr(fetch_semaphore, "acquire")
 954            ):
 955                while fetch_semaphore.active >= fetch_semaphore.limit:
 956                    await asyncio.sleep(0)
 957                await fetch_semaphore.__aenter__()
 958                acquired_dummy = True
 959            else:
 960                await fetch_semaphore.acquire()
 961            try:
 962                async with aiohttp.ClientSession(timeout=timeout) as session:
 963                    async with session.get(
 964                        url, params=params, headers=headers, proxy=proxy
 965                    ) as resp:
 966                        if resp.status == 429:
 967                            metrics.scrape_block.inc()
 968                        if 500 <= resp.status < 600:
 969                            raise aiohttp.ClientResponseError(
 970                                resp.request_info,
 971                                resp.history,
 972                                status=resp.status,
 973                                message=resp.reason,
 974                                headers=resp.headers,
 975                            )
 976                        resp.raise_for_status()
 977                        rate_limiter.record_success()
 978                        return resp.status, await resp.text()
 979            finally:
 980                if acquired_dummy:
 981                    await fetch_semaphore.__aexit__(None, None, None)
 982                else:
 983                    fetch_semaphore.release()
 984        except aiohttp.ClientResponseError as e:
 985            if getattr(e, "status", None) == 429:
 986                logger.warning(f"HTTP 429 for {url}, backing off")
 987                rate_limiter.record_error()
 988            else:
 989                logger.warning(f"Attempt {attempt} failed for {url}: {e}")
 990            exc = e
 991        except asyncio.TimeoutError as e:
 992            logger.warning(f"Timeout while fetching {url}")
 993            rate_limiter.record_error()
 994            exc = e
 995        except Exception as e:
 996            logger.warning(f"Attempt {attempt} failed for {url}: {e}")
 997            exc = e
 998        if attempt < retries:
 999            metrics.request_retries_total.inc()
1000            await asyncio.sleep(2)
1001        else:
1002            log_failed_url(url)
1003            metrics.requests_failed_total.inc()
1004            raise exc
1005

1013async def fetch_html_content_async(title: str, lang: str) -> str:
1014    """Asynchronous version of :func:`fetch_html_content`."""
1015    cache_key = f"html_{lang}_{title}"
1016    cached = cache.get(cache_key)
1017
1018    url = f"{get_base_url(lang)}/api/rest_v1/page/html/{title}"
1019    headers = {"User-Agent": Config.get_random_user_agent()}
1020
1021    try:
1022        await rate_limiter.async_wait()
1023        _, html = await fetch_with_retry(url, headers=headers)
1024        metrics.scrape_success.inc()
1025        cache.set(cache_key, html, ttl=Config.CACHE_TTL)
1026        return html
1027    except Exception as e:
1028        metrics.scrape_error.inc()
1029        logger.error(f"Erro ao buscar HTML para {title}: {e}")
1030        if cached is not None:
1031            return cached
1032        return ""

1035async def fetch_all(urls: List[str]) -> List[str]:
1036    """Fetch multiple URLs concurrently using ``fetch_with_retry``."""

1038    return [text for _, text in results]

1041def search_category(keyword: str, lang: str) -> Optional[str]:
1042    """Search for a similar category name using the Wikipedia API."""
1043    cache_key = f"search_category_{lang}_{keyword}"
1044    cached = cache.get(cache_key)
1045    if cached is not None:
1046        return cached
1047
1048    url = f"{get_base_url(lang)}/w/api.php"
1049    params = {
1050        "action": "query",
1051        "list": "search",
1052        "srnamespace": 14,
1053        "srsearch": keyword,
1054        "format": "json",
1055    }
1056
1057    async def _async_search() -> Optional[str]:
1058        await rate_limiter.async_wait()
1059        status, text = await fetch_with_retry(
1060            url, params=params, headers={"User-Agent": Config.get_random_user_agent()}
1061        )
1062        if status == 429:
1063            rate_limiter.record_error()
1064        data = json.loads(text)
1065        results = data.get("query", {}).get("search", [])
1066        if results:
1067            title = results[0].get("title", "")
1068            title = title.replace("Category:", "").replace("Categoria:", "")
1069            cache.set(cache_key, title, ttl=Config.CACHE_TTL)
1070            return title
1071        return None
1072
1073    try:
1074        return asyncio.run(_async_search()) or cache.get(cache_key)
1075    except Exception as e:  # pragma: no cover - network issues
1076        rate_limiter.record_error()
1077        logger.error(f"Erro ao buscar categorias para {keyword}: {e}")
1078        return cache.get(cache_key)

1081def get_revision_history(title: str, lang: str, limit: int) -> List[dict]:
1082    """Return revision metadata for a page using the Wikipedia API."""
1083
1084    cache_key = f"revisions_{lang}_{title}_{limit}"
1085    cached = cache.get(cache_key)
1086    if cached is not None:
1087        return cached
1088
1089    url = f"{get_base_url(lang)}/w/api.php"
1090    params = {
1091        "action": "query",
1092        "prop": "revisions",
1093        "titles": title,
1094        "rvlimit": limit,
1095        "rvprop": "timestamp|user",
1096        "format": "json",
1097    }
1098
1099    @backoff.on_exception(
1100        backoff.expo,
1101        requests.exceptions.RequestException,
1102        max_tries=Config.RETRIES,
1103    )
1104    def _request() -> List[dict]:
1105        rate_limiter.wait()
1106        resp = requests.get(
1107            url,
1108            params=params,
1109            headers={"User-Agent": Config.get_random_user_agent()},
1110            timeout=Config.TIMEOUT,
1111        )
1112        resp.raise_for_status()
1113        data = resp.json()
1114        pages = data.get("query", {}).get("pages", {})
1115        revs: List[dict] = []
1116        for page in pages.values():
1117            for rev in page.get("revisions", []):
1118                revs.append(
1119                    {
1120                        "timestamp": rev.get("timestamp"),
1121                        "user": rev.get("user"),
1122                    }
1123                )
1124        return revs
1125
1126    try:
1127        revisions = _request()
1128        cache.set(cache_key, revisions, ttl=Config.CACHE_TTL)
1129        return revisions
1130    except Exception as e:  # pragma: no cover - network issues
1131        logger.error(f"Erro ao buscar revisões de {title}: {e}")
1132        fallback = cache.get(cache_key)
1133        if fallback is not None:
1134            return fallback
1135        return []

1141class WikipediaAdvanced:
1142    def __init__(self, lang: str):
1143        self.lang = lang
1144        self.wiki = wikipediaapi.Wikipedia(
1145            language=lang,
1146            extract_format=wikipediaapi.ExtractFormat.HTML,
1147            user_agent=Config.get_random_user_agent(),
1148        )
1149        self.session = requests.Session()
1150        self.session.headers.update({"User-Agent": Config.get_random_user_agent()})
1151
1152    def _prepare_session(self):
1153        """Refresh User-Agent and proxy settings before a request."""
1154        self.session.headers["User-Agent"] = Config.get_random_user_agent()
1155        if Config.PROXIES:
1156            self.session.proxies = get_next_proxy()
1157        else:
1158            self.session.proxies = {}
1159
1160    @backoff.on_exception(
1161        backoff.expo,
1162        (requests.exceptions.RequestException, wikipediaapi.WikipediaException),
1163        max_tries=Config.RETRIES,
1164    )
1165    def fetch_page(self, page_title: str) -> Optional[wikipediaapi.WikipediaPage]:
1166        cache_key = f"page_{self.lang}_{page_title}"
1167        cached = cache.get(cache_key)
1168        if cached is not None:
1169            return cached
1170
1171        self._prepare_session()
1172        rate_limiter.wait()
1173
1174        try:
1175            page = self.wiki.page(page_title)
1176            if page.exists():
1177                # Melhora a qualidade do conteúdo
1178                page._fullurl = self.wiki.api.article_url(page_title)
1179                rate_limiter.wait()
1180                page._html = fetch_html_content(page_title, self.lang)
1181                page._html = extract_main_content(page._html)
1182
1183                cache.set(cache_key, page, ttl=Config.CACHE_TTL)
1184                return page
1185        except Exception as e:
1186            rate_limiter.record_error()
1187            logger.error(f"Erro ao buscar página {page_title}: {e}")
1188            log_failed_url(self.wiki.api.article_url(page_title))
1189            raise
1190
1191        return None
1192
1193    async def fetch_page_async(
1194        self, page_title: str
1195    ) -> Optional[wikipediaapi.WikipediaPage]:
1196        """Asynchronous version of :meth:`fetch_page` using ``aiohttp``."""
1197        cache_key = f"page_{self.lang}_{page_title}"
1198        cached = cache.get(cache_key)
1199        if cached is not None:
1200            return cached
1201
1202        await rate_limiter.async_wait()
1203
1204        try:
1205            page = await asyncio.to_thread(self.wiki.page, page_title)
1206            if page.exists():
1207                page._fullurl = self.wiki.api.article_url(page_title)
1208                await rate_limiter.async_wait()
1209                page._html = await fetch_html_content_async(page_title, self.lang)
1210                page._html = extract_main_content(page._html)
1211                cache.set(cache_key, page, ttl=Config.CACHE_TTL)
1212                return page
1213        except Exception as e:
1214            rate_limiter.record_error()
1215            logger.error(f"Erro ao buscar página {page_title}: {e}")
1216            log_failed_url(self.wiki.api.article_url(page_title))
1217            raise
1218
1219        return None
1220
1221    @backoff.on_exception(
1222        backoff.expo,
1223        (requests.exceptions.RequestException, wikipediaapi.WikipediaException),
1224        max_tries=Config.RETRIES,
1225    )
1226    def fetch_category(

1230            f"Category:{category_name}"

1253    def get_related_pages(self, page_title: str, limit: int = 10) -> List[dict]:
1254        cache_key = f"related_{self.lang}_{page_title}"
1255        cached = cache.get(cache_key)
1256        if cached is not None:
1257            return cached
1258
1259        self._prepare_session()
1260
1261        @backoff.on_exception(
1262            backoff.expo,
1263            (requests.exceptions.RequestException, wikipediaapi.WikipediaException),
1264            max_tries=Config.RETRIES,
1265        )
1266        def _request():
1267            url = f"{get_base_url(self.lang)}/w/api.php"
1268            params = {
1269                "action": "query",
1270                "titles": page_title,
1271                "prop": "links",
1272                "pllimit": limit,
1273                "format": "json",
1274            }
1275            rate_limiter.wait()
1276            response = self.session.get(url, params=params, timeout=Config.TIMEOUT)
1277            response.raise_for_status()
1278            return response.json()
1279
1280        try:
1281            data = _request()
1282
1283            pages = data.get("query", {}).get("pages", {})
1284            links = []
1285
1286            for page in pages.values():
1287                for link in page.get("links", []):
1288                    if "ns" in link and link["ns"] == 0:  # Only main namespace
1289                        links.append({"title": link["title"], "lang": self.lang})
1290
1291            cache.set(cache_key, links, ttl=Config.CACHE_TTL)
1292            return links
1293        except Exception as e:
1294            logger.error(f"Erro ao buscar páginas relacionadas para {page_title}: {e}")
1295            log_failed_url(f"{get_base_url(self.lang)}/w/api.php")
1296            fallback = cache.get(cache_key)
1297            if fallback is not None:
1298                return fallback
1299            return []

1306    def get_category_members(
1307        self, category_name: str, depth: int = 0, visited: Optional[Set[str]] = None
1308    ) -> List[dict]:
1309        if visited is None:
1310            visited = set()
1311
1312        category = self.fetch_category(category_name)
1313        if not category or not category.exists():
1314            alt = search_category(category_name, self.lang)
1315            if alt:
1316                category_name = alt
1317                category = self.fetch_category(category_name)
1318
1319        if not category or not category.exists():
1320            logger.warning(f"Categoria não encontrada: {category_name}")
1321            return []
1322
1323        members = []
1324        for member in category.categorymembers.values():
1325            if member.title not in visited:
1326                visited.add(member.title)
1327
1328                if (
1329                    member.ns == wikipediaapi.Namespace.CATEGORY
1330                    and depth < Config.MAX_DEPTH
1331                ):
1332                    sub_members = self.get_category_members(
1333                        member.title.replace("Category:", "").replace("Categoria:", ""),
1334                        depth + 1,
1335                        visited,
1336                    )
1337                    members.extend(sub_members)
1338                elif member.ns == wikipediaapi.Namespace.MAIN:
1339                    members.append(
1340                        {
1341                            "title": member.title,
1342                            "url": member.fullurl,
1343                            "lang": self.lang,
1344                            "category": category_name,
1345                            "depth": depth,
1346                        }
1347                    )
1348
1349                if len(members) >= Config.MAX_PAGES_PER_CATEGORY:
1350                    break
1351
1352        return members
1353
1354    async def get_category_members_async(
1355        self,
1356        category_name: str,
1357        depth: int = 0,
1358        visited: Optional[Set[str]] = None,
1359        max_concurrency: Optional[int] = None,
1360    ) -> List[dict]:
1361        """Asynchronously fetch category members recursively."""
1362        if visited is None:
1363            visited = set()
1364
1365        max_concurrency = max_concurrency or Config.MAX_CONCURRENT_REQUESTS
1366        sem = asyncio.Semaphore(max_concurrency)
1367
1368        category = await asyncio.to_thread(self.fetch_category, category_name)
1369        if not category or not category.exists():
1370            alt = search_category(category_name, self.lang)
1371            if alt:
1372                category_name = alt
1373                category = await asyncio.to_thread(self.fetch_category, category_name)
1374
1375        if not category or not category.exists():
1376            logger.warning(f"Categoria não encontrada: {category_name}")
1377            return []
1378
1379        members: List[dict] = []
1380
1381        async def handle_member(member):
1382            if member.title in visited:
1383                return []
1384            visited.add(member.title)
1385
1386            if (
1387                member.ns == wikipediaapi.Namespace.CATEGORY
1388                and depth < Config.MAX_DEPTH
1389            ):
1390                async with sem:
1391                    return await self.get_category_members_async(
1392                        member.title.replace("Category:", "").replace("Categoria:", ""),
1393                        depth + 1,
1394                        visited,
1395                        max_concurrency,
1396                    )
1397            elif member.ns == wikipediaapi.Namespace.MAIN:
1398                return [
1399                    {
1400                        "title": member.title,
1401                        "url": member.fullurl,
1402                        "lang": self.lang,
1403                        "category": category_name,
1404                        "depth": depth,
1405                    }
1406                ]
1407            return []
1408
1409        tasks = [handle_member(m) for m in category.categorymembers.values()]
1410        for res in await asyncio.gather(*tasks):
1411            members.extend(res)
1412            if len(members) >= Config.MAX_PAGES_PER_CATEGORY:
1413                break
1414
1415        return members
1416
1417    def crawl_links(
1418        self,
1419        start_page: str,
1420        depth: int = 1,
1421        visited: Optional[Set[str]] = None,
1422    ) -> List[dict]:
1423        """Breadth-first crawl of ``/wiki/`` links starting from ``start_page``.
1424
1425        Parameters
1426        ----------
1427        start_page: str
1428            Title of the initial page to crawl.
1429        depth: int
1430            Maximum link depth to follow.
1431        visited: Optional[Set[str]]
1432            Optional set of already visited titles to avoid repeats.
1433
1434        Returns
1435        -------
1436        List[dict]
1437            List of pages in the same format as :meth:`get_category_members`.
1438        """
1439        if visited is None:
1440            visited = set()
1441
1442        queue: List[Tuple[str, int]] = [(start_page, 0)]
1443        results: List[dict] = []
1444        base_url = get_base_url(self.lang)
1445
1446        while queue and len(results) < Config.MAX_PAGES_PER_CATEGORY:
1447            current, cur_depth = queue.pop(0)
1448            if current in visited:
1449                continue
1450            visited.add(current)
1451
1452            try:
1453                html = fetch_html_content(current, self.lang)
1454                links = extract_links(html, base_url)
1455            except Exception as e:
1456                logger.error(f"Erro ao rastrear links de {current}: {e}")
1457                continue
1458
1459            for link in links:
1460                if len(results) >= Config.MAX_PAGES_PER_CATEGORY:
1461                    break
1462                parsed = urlparse(link)
1463                if "/wiki/" not in parsed.path:
1464                    continue
1465                title = parsed.path.split("/wiki/")[-1]
1466                title = requests.utils.unquote(title).replace("_", " ")
1467                if title in visited:
1468                    continue
1469                results.append(
1470                    {
1471                        "title": title,
1472                        "url": link,
1473                        "lang": self.lang,
1474                        "category": start_page,
1475                        "depth": cur_depth,
1476                    }
1477                )
1478                if cur_depth < depth:
1479                    queue.append((title, cur_depth + 1))
1480
1481        return results
1482
1483    async def crawl_links_async(
1484        self,
1485        start_page: str,
1486        depth: int = 1,

1488    ) -> List[dict]:

1540
1541def cpu_process_page(
1542    title: str,
1543    content: str,
1544    lang: str,
1545    category: str,
1546    images: List[Dict[str, str]] | None = None,
1547    revisions: List[dict] | None = None,
1548    rev_limit: int = 5,
1549) -> dict:
1550    """Executes CPU intensive operations for a page."""
1551    builder = DatasetBuilder(include_revisions=revisions, rev_limit=rev_limit)
1552    summary = summarize_text(content, lang)
1553    record = builder.generate_qa_pairs(
1554        title=title,
1555        content=content,
1556        summary=summary,
1557        lang=lang,
1558        category=category,
1559    )
1560    record["entities"] = extract_entities(content)
1561    if images is not None:
1562        record["images"] = images
1563    if revisions is not None:
1564        record.setdefault("metadata", {})["revisions"] = revisions
1565    return record
1566
1567
1568class DatasetBuilder:
1569    def __init__(
1570        self,
1571        include_revisions: bool = False,
1572        rev_limit: int = 5,
1573        min_complexity: int | None = None,
1574        max_complexity: int | None = None,
1575        **_,
1576    ):
1577        self.embedding_model = NLPProcessor.get_embedding_model()
1578        self.dataset = []
1579        self.qa_pairs = []
1580        self.pending_pages: List[dict] = []
1581        self.duplicates_removed = 0
1582        self.invalid_records = 0
1583        self.include_revisions = include_revisions
1584        self.rev_limit = rev_limit
1585        self.min_complexity = min_complexity
1586        self.max_complexity = max_complexity
1587
1588        # Load checkpoints if available
1589        pages_path = os.path.join(Config.LOG_DIR, "checkpoint_pages.json")
1590        data_path = os.path.join(Config.LOG_DIR, "checkpoint_data.json")
1591        if os.path.exists(data_path):
1592            try:
1593                with open(data_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
1594                    self.dataset = json.load(f)
1595            except Exception as e:  # pragma: no cover - corrupted file
1596                logger.error(f"Erro ao carregar {data_path}: {e}")
1597            else:
1598                try:
1599                    os.remove(data_path)
1600                except OSError:
1601                    pass
1602        if os.path.exists(pages_path):
1603            try:
1604                with open(pages_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
1605                    self.pending_pages = json.load(f)
1606            except Exception as e:  # pragma: no cover - corrupted file
1607                logger.error(f"Erro ao carregar {pages_path}: {e}")
1608            else:
1609                try:
1610                    os.remove(pages_path)
1611                except OSError:
1612                    pass
1613        if self.dataset or self.pending_pages:
1614            self._update_progress()
1615
1616    def _update_progress(self):
1617        """Update progress information in logs/progress.json"""
1618        try:
1619            os.makedirs(Config.LOG_DIR, exist_ok=True)
1620            progress_file = os.path.join(Config.LOG_DIR, "progress.json")
1621            temp_file = progress_file + ".tmp"
1622
1623            clusters = sorted(
1624                {item.get("cluster") for item in self.dataset if "cluster" in item}
1625            )
1626            topics = sorted(
1627                {item.get("topic") for item in self.dataset if item.get("topic")}
1628            )
1629            languages = sorted(
1630                {item.get("language") for item in self.dataset if item.get("language")}
1631            )
1632
1633            progress = {
1634                "pages_processed": len(self.dataset),
1635                "clusters": clusters,
1636                "topics": topics,
1637                "languages": languages,
1638                "duplicates_removed": self.duplicates_removed,
1639                "invalid_records": self.invalid_records,
1640            }
1641
1642            with open(temp_file, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
1643                json.dump(progress, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
1644            os.replace(temp_file, progress_file)
1645
1646            data_path = os.path.join(Config.LOG_DIR, "checkpoint_data.json")
1647            pages_path = os.path.join(Config.LOG_DIR, "checkpoint_pages.json")
1648            with open(data_path + ".tmp", "w", encoding="utf-8") as df:
1649                json.dump(self.dataset, df, ensure_ascii=False)
1650            os.replace(data_path + ".tmp", data_path)
1651            with open(pages_path + ".tmp", "w", encoding="utf-8") as pf:
1652                json.dump(self.pending_pages, pf, ensure_ascii=False)
1653            os.replace(pages_path + ".tmp", pages_path)
1654        except Exception as e:
1655            logger.error(f"Erro ao atualizar progresso: {e}")
1656
1657    def process_page(
1658        self, page_info: dict, proc_executor: Optional[ProcessPoolExecutor] = None
1659    ) -> Optional[object]:
1660        start_time = time.perf_counter()
1661        try:
1662            wiki = WikipediaAdvanced(page_info["lang"])
1663            page = wiki.fetch_page(page_info["title"])
1664
1665            if not page or not page.exists():
1666                return None
1667
1668            # Extrai e limpa o texto
1669            raw_text = clean_text(page.text)
1670            clean_content = advanced_clean_text(
1671                raw_text,
1672                page_info["lang"],
1673                remove_stopwords=Config.REMOVE_STOPWORDS,
1674            )
1675
1676            if len(clean_content) < Config.MIN_TEXT_LENGTH:
1677                return None
1678
1679            if proc_executor:
1680                images = extract_images(getattr(page, "_html", ""))
1681                revisions = None
1682                if self.include_revisions:
1683                    revisions = wiki.get_revision_history(
1684                        page_info["title"], self.rev_limit
1685                    )
1686                return proc_executor.submit(
1687                    cpu_process_page,
1688                    page_info["title"],
1689                    clean_content,
1690                    page_info["lang"],
1691                    page_info.get("category", ""),
1692                    images,
1693                    revisions,
1694                    self.rev_limit,
1695                )
1696
1697            # Sumariza o conteúdo
1698            summary = summarize_text(clean_content, page_info["lang"])
1699
1700            # Gera QA pairs avançadas
1701            qa_data = self.generate_qa_pairs(
1702                title=page_info["title"],
1703                content=clean_content,
1704                summary=summary,
1705                lang=page_info["lang"],
1706                category=page_info.get("category", ""),
1707            )
1708            qa_data["entities"] = extract_entities(clean_content)
1709            images = extract_images(getattr(page, "_html", ""))
1710            qa_data["images"] = images
1711            if self.include_revisions:
1712                qa_data.setdefault("metadata", {})["revisions"] = (
1713                    wiki.get_revision_history(page_info["title"], self.rev_limit)
1714                )
1715            metrics.scrape_success.inc()
1716            metrics.pages_scraped_total.inc()
1717            return qa_data
1718        except Exception as e:
1719            metrics.scrape_error.inc()
1720            logger.error(f"Erro ao processar página {page_info.get('title', '')}: {e}")
1721            return None
1722        finally:
1723            metrics.page_processing_seconds.observe(time.perf_counter() - start_time)
1724
1725    async def process_page_async(
1726        self, page_info: dict, proc_executor: Optional[ProcessPoolExecutor] = None
1727    ) -> Optional[object]:
1728        """Asynchronous wrapper for :meth:`process_page`."""
1729        return await asyncio.to_thread(self.process_page, page_info, proc_executor)
1730
1731    def generate_qa_pairs(
1732        self,
1733        title: str,
1734        content: str,
1735        summary: str,
1736        lang: str,
1737        category: str,
1738        extra_metadata: dict | None = None,
1739    ) -> dict:
1740        raw_code = content
1741        code_lang = detect_programming_language(content)
1742        complexities = {}
1743        docstring = ""
1744        signature = ""
1745        problems: list[str] = []
1746        fixed_version = content
1747        if code_lang != "unknown":
1748            signature = parse_function_signature(content)
1749            try:
1750                tree = ast.parse(content)
1751                func = next(
1752                    (
1753                        n
1754                        for n in tree.body
1755                        if isinstance(n, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef))
1756                    ),
1757                    None,
1758                )
1759                if func:
1760                    ds = ast.get_docstring(func)
1761                    if ds:
1762                        docstring = docstring_to_google(ds)
1763            except Exception:
1764                pass
1765            content = normalize_indentation(remove_comments(content, code_lang))
1766            complexities = get_functions_complexity(content, code_lang)
1767            problems, fixed_version = scan_code(content)
1768            if self.min_complexity is not None and complexities:
1769                if max(complexities.values()) < self.min_complexity:
1770                    return {}
1771            if self.max_complexity is not None and complexities:
1772                if max(complexities.values()) > self.max_complexity:
1773                    return {}
1774        else:
1775            problems, fixed_version = scan_code(content)
1776
1777        # Extrai keywords para gerar perguntas variadas
1778        keywords = extract_keywords(content, lang)
1779
1780        tags = self._extract_tags(keywords, extra_metadata)
1781
1782        # Gera múltiplas perguntas baseadas no conteúdo
1783        questions = self._generate_questions(title, content, lang, keywords)
1784
1785        # Gera respostas completas
1786        answers = self._generate_answers(content, summary, lang)
1787
1788        # Relações semânticas básicas
1789        relations = extract_relations(content, lang)
1790        relations_regex = extract_relations_regex(content)
1791        relations.extend(r for r in relations_regex if r not in relations)
1792
1793        # Cria embeddings para busca semântica
1794        content_embedding = self.embedding_model.encode(
1795            content, show_progress_bar=False
1796        )
1797        summary_embedding = self.embedding_model.encode(
1798            summary, show_progress_bar=False
1799        )
1800
1801        # Classificação avançada de tópicos
1802        topic, subtopic = self._classify_topic(title, content, lang)
1803
1804        record = {
1805            "id": hashlib.md5(f"{title}_{lang}".encode("utf-8")).hexdigest(),
1806            "title": title,
1807            "language": lang,
1808            "category": category,
1809            "topic": topic,
1810            "subtopic": subtopic,
1811            "keywords": keywords,
1812            "tags": tags,
1813            "content": content,
1814            "raw_code": raw_code if code_lang != "unknown" else "",
1815            "summary": summary,
1816            "context": summary,
1817            "problems": problems,
1818            "fixed_version": fixed_version,
1819            "lessons": extra_metadata.get("lessons", "") if extra_metadata else "",
1820            "origin_metrics": (
1821                extra_metadata.get("origin_metrics", {}) if extra_metadata else {}
1822            ),
1823            "challenge": (extra_metadata.get("challenge") if extra_metadata else None)
1824            or generate_challenge_prompt(problems),
1825            "content_embedding": content_embedding.tolist(),
1826            "summary_embedding": summary_embedding.tolist(),
1827            "quality_score": (
1828                extra_metadata.get("quality_score", 0.0) if extra_metadata else 0.0
1829            ),
1830            "quality": None,
1831            "reason": "",
1832            "questions": questions,
1833            "answers": answers,
1834            "relations": relations,
1835            "tests": extra_metadata.get("tests", []) if extra_metadata else [],
1836            "docstring": docstring,
1837            "created_at": datetime.utcnow().isoformat(),
1838            "metadata": {
1839                "length": len(content),
1840                "source": "wikipedia",
1841                "source_url": f"{get_base_url(lang)}/wiki/{title.replace(' ', '_')}",
1842            },
1843        }
1844
1845        # Determine quality classification when possible
1846        if extra_metadata:
1847            if any(
1848                k in extra_metadata for k in ["stars", "stargazers_count", "repository"]
1849            ):
1850                q, r = classify_github_repo(extra_metadata)
1851                record["quality"], record["reason"] = q, r
1852            elif "score" in extra_metadata:
1853                q, r = classify_stackoverflow_answer(extra_metadata)
1854                record["quality"], record["reason"] = q, r
1855        if record["quality"] is None:
1856            score = record.get("quality_score", 0.0)
1857            if score >= 5:
1858                record["quality"] = "high"
1859            elif score >= 2:
1860                record["quality"] = "medium"
1861            else:
1862                record["quality"] = "low"
1863            record["reason"] = "quality score"
1864        if code_lang != "unknown":
1865            record["metadata"]["code_language"] = code_lang
1866            if complexities:
1867                record["metadata"]["complexities"] = complexities
1868            if docstring:
1869                record["docstring"] = docstring
1870            if signature:
1871                record["signature"] = signature
1872        if extra_metadata:
1873            if "wikidata_id" in extra_metadata:
1874                record["wikidata_id"] = extra_metadata["wikidata_id"]
1875            if "image_url" in extra_metadata:
1876                record["image_url"] = extra_metadata["image_url"]
1877        try:
1878            storage_sqlite.save_to_db(
1879                {"id": record["id"], "metadata": record.get("metadata", {})}
1880            )
1881        except Exception as e:
1882            logger.error(f"Erro ao salvar no SQLite: {e}")
1883        return record
1884
1885    def _generate_questions(
1886        self, title: str, content: str, lang: str, keywords: List[str]
1887    ) -> List[dict]:
1888        questions = []
1889
1890        # Pergunta básica sobre o título
1891        base_question = {
1892            "text": self._translate_question(f"What is {title}?", lang),
1893            "type": "definition",
1894            "difficulty": "easy",
1895        }
1896        questions.append(base_question)
1897
1898        # Perguntas baseadas em keywords
1899        for keyword in keywords[:5]:  # Limita a 5 perguntas por keyword
1900            question_types = [
1901                (f"How does {keyword} relate to {title}?", "relation", "medium"),
1902                (f"What is the role of {keyword} in {title}?", "role", "medium"),
1903                (
1904                    f"Can you explain {keyword} in the context of {title}?",
1905                    "explanation",
1906                    "hard",
1907                ),
1908            ]
1909
1910            for q_text, q_type, q_diff in question_types:
1911                questions.append(
1912                    {
1913                        "text": self._translate_question(q_text, lang),
1914                        "type": q_type,
1915                        "difficulty": q_diff,
1916                    }
1917                )
1918
1919        # Perguntas baseadas em conteúdo (usando NLP)
1920        try:
1921            nlp = NLPProcessor.get_instance(lang)
1922            doc = nlp(content)
1923
1924            # Perguntas sobre entidades nomeadas
1925            for ent in doc.ents[:5]:  # Limita a 5 entidades
1926                if ent.label_ in ["PERSON", "ORG", "LOC", "PRODUCT"]:
1927                    questions.append(
1928                        {
1929                            "text": self._translate_question(
1930                                f"What is the significance of {ent.text} in {title}?",
1931                                lang,
1932                            ),
1933                            "type": "significance",
1934                            "difficulty": "medium",
1935                        }
1936                    )
1937
1938            # Perguntas sobre verbos/ações
1939            for sent in doc.sents[:3]:  # Analisa as primeiras 3 sentenças
1940                root = [token for token in sent if token.dep_ == "ROOT"]
1941                if root:
1942                    verb = root[0].lemma_
1943                    questions.append(
1944                        {
1945                            "text": self._translate_question(
1946                                f"How does {title} {verb}?", lang
1947                            ),
1948                            "type": "process",
1949                            "difficulty": "hard",
1950                        }
1951                    )
1952        except Exception as e:
1953            logger.error(f"Erro ao gerar perguntas NLP para {title}: {e}")
1954
1955        return questions
1956
1957    def _generate_answers(self, content: str, summary: str, lang: str) -> List[dict]:
1958        answers = []
1959
1960        # Resposta resumida
1961        answers.append({"text": summary, "type": "summary", "length": "short"})
1962
1963        # Resposta completa
1964        answers.append(
1965            {
1966                "text": content[: Config.MAX_TEXT_LENGTH],  # Limita o tamanho
1967                "type": "detailed",
1968                "length": "long",
1969            }
1970        )
1971
1972        # Respostas específicas por parágrafo
1973        paragraphs = [p for p in content.split("\n") if len(p.strip()) > 0]
1974        for para in paragraphs[:3]:  # Limita a 3 parágrafos
1975            answers.append({"text": para, "type": "paragraph", "length": "medium"})
1976
1977        return answers
1978
1979    def _translate_question(self, question: str, lang: str) -> str:
1980        translations = {
1981            "pt": {

1983                "How does": "Como",
1984                "relate to": "se relaciona com",
1985                "What is the role of": "Qual é o papel de",
1986                "Can you explain": "Você pode explicar",
1987                "in the context of": "no contexto de",
1988                "What is the significance of": "Qual é a importância de",
1989            },
1990            "es": {
1991                "What is": "Qué es",
1992                "How does": "Cómo",
1993                "relate to": "se relaciona con",
1994                "What is the role of": "Cuál es el papel de",
1995                "Can you explain": "Puedes explicar",
1996                "in the context of": "en el contexto de",
1997                "What is the significance of": "Cuál es la importancia de",
1998            },
1999            "fr": {
2000                "What is": "Qu'est-ce que",
2001                "How does": "Comment",
2002                "relate to": "se rapporte à",
2003                "What is the role of": "Quel est le rôle de",

2125    def build_from_pages(
2126        self,
2127        pages: List[dict],
2128        progress_desc: str = "Processando páginas",
2129        use_queue: bool = False,
2130        client=None,
2131    ) -> List[dict]:
2132        """Process pages locally or enfileira tarefas para processamento."""
2133        if self.pending_pages:
2134            pages = self.pending_pages
2135        else:
2136            self.pending_pages = pages.copy()
2137
2138        if client:
2139            futures = [client.submit(self.process_page, page) for page in pages]
2140            processed = 0
2141            total = len(futures)
2142            for fut in tqdm(futures, total=total, desc=progress_desc):
2143                result = fut.result()
2144                processed += 1
2145                if processed % 10 == 0 or processed == total:
2146                    logger.info(f"Distributed progress: {processed}/{total}")
2147                page = pages[processed - 1]
2148                if page in self.pending_pages:
2149                    self.pending_pages.remove(page)
2150                if result:
2151                    self.dataset.append(result)
2152                self._update_progress()
2153            return self.dataset
2154
2155        if not use_queue:
2156            cpu_futures = []
2157            with ThreadPoolExecutor(
2158                max_workers=Config.MAX_THREADS
2159            ) as th_executor, ProcessPoolExecutor(
2160                max_workers=Config.MAX_PROCESSES
2161            ) as pr_executor:
2162                page_futures = {
2163                    th_executor.submit(self.process_page, page, pr_executor): page
2164                    for page in pages
2165                }
2166
2167                processed = 0
2168                total = len(page_futures)
2169                for future in tqdm(
2170                    as_completed(page_futures), total=total, desc=progress_desc
2171                ):
2172                    cpu_future = future.result()
2173                    page = page_futures[future]
2174                    processed += 1
2175                    if page in self.pending_pages:
2176                        self.pending_pages.remove(page)
2177                    if processed % 10 == 0 or processed == total:
2178                        logger.info(f"Thread progress: {processed}/{total}")
2179                    if cpu_future:
2180                        cpu_futures.append(cpu_future)
2181                    self._update_progress()
2182
2183                processed_cpu = 0
2184                total_cpu = len(cpu_futures)
2185                for future in tqdm(
2186                    as_completed(cpu_futures),
2187                    total=total_cpu,
2188                    desc="Processando conteúdo",
2189                ):
2190                    result = future.result()
2191                    processed_cpu += 1
2192                    if processed_cpu % 10 == 0 or processed_cpu == total_cpu:
2193                        logger.info(f"Process progress: {processed_cpu}/{total_cpu}")
2194                    if result:
2195                        self.dataset.append(result)
2196                    self._update_progress()
2197
2198            return self.dataset
2199
2200        # Queue based processing
2201        from task_queue import publish, consume
2202
2203        for page in pages:
2204            publish("scrape_tasks", page)
2205
2206        processed = 0
2207        total = len(pages)
2208        for result in consume("scrape_results"):
2209            if result is None:
2210                continue
2211            processed += 1
2212            for p in list(self.pending_pages):
2213                if p.get("title") == result.get("title") and p.get(
2214                    "lang", p.get("language")
2215                ) == result.get("language"):
2216                    self.pending_pages.remove(p)
2217                    break
2218            self.dataset.append(result)
2219            self._update_progress()
2220            if processed % 10 == 0 or processed == total:
2221                logger.info(f"Queue progress: {processed}/{total}")
2222            if processed == total:
2223                break
2224
2225        return self.dataset
2226
2227    async def build_from_pages_async(
2228        self, pages: List[dict], progress_desc: str = "Processando páginas"
2229    ) -> List[dict]:
2230        """Asynchronous version of :meth:`build_from_pages`."""
2231        if self.pending_pages:
2232            pages = self.pending_pages
2233        else:
2234            self.pending_pages = pages.copy()
2235
2236        cpu_futures = []
2237        with ProcessPoolExecutor(max_workers=Config.MAX_PROCESSES) as pr_executor:
2238            tasks = [self.process_page_async(page, pr_executor) for page in pages]
2239
2240            processed = 0
2241            total = len(tasks)
2242            for coro in tqdm(
2243                asyncio.as_completed(tasks), total=total, desc=progress_desc
2244            ):
2245                cpu_future = await coro
2246                processed += 1
2247                if self.pending_pages:
2248                    self.pending_pages.pop(0)
2249                if processed % 10 == 0 or processed == total:
2250                    logger.info(f"Async progress: {processed}/{total}")
2251                if cpu_future:
2252                    cpu_futures.append(cpu_future)
2253                self._update_progress()
2254
2255            processed_cpu = 0
2256            total_cpu = len(cpu_futures)
2257            for future in tqdm(
2258                as_completed(cpu_futures), total=total_cpu, desc="Processando conteúdo"
2259            ):
2260                result = future.result()
2261                processed_cpu += 1
2262                if processed_cpu % 10 == 0 or processed_cpu == total_cpu:
2263                    logger.info(f"Process progress: {processed_cpu}/{total_cpu}")
2264                if result:
2265                    self.dataset.append(result)
2266                self._update_progress()
2267
2268        return self.dataset

2287    def save_dataset(self, format: str = "all", output_dir: str = Config.OUTPUT_DIR):
2288        os.makedirs(output_dir, exist_ok=True)
2289
2290        if not self.dataset:
2291            logger.warning("Nenhum dado para salvar")
2292            return
2293
2294        # Balance records by quality before further processing
2295        try:
2296            self.dataset = balance_quality(self.dataset)
2297        except Exception:
2298            pass
2299
2300        for rec in self.dataset:
2301            if "content" in rec:
2302                rec["content"] = dq.strip_credentials(rec["content"])
2303
2304        # Remove near-duplicates based on Simhash
2305        try:
2306            self.dataset, rem_sim = dq.deduplicate_by_simhash(self.dataset)
2307            self.duplicates_removed += rem_sim
2308        except Exception as e:  # pragma: no cover - library issues
2309            logger.error(f"Erro na deduplicação Simhash: {e}")
2310
2311        try:
2312            plag = dq.detect_code_plagiarism(self.dataset)
2313            if plag:
2314                logger.warning(f"Registros plagiados removidos: {len(plag)}")
2315                self.dataset = [r for r in self.dataset if r not in plag]
2316                self.invalid_records += len(plag)
2317        except Exception as e:  # pragma: no cover - library issues
2318            logger.error(f"Erro na verificação de plágio: {e}")
2319
2320        # Validação dos registros antes de salvar
2321        validated_data = []
2322        for item in self.dataset:
2323            valid = True
2324
2325            # Checa se embeddings contêm apenas números finitos
2326            if not np.all(np.isfinite(item.get("content_embedding", []))):
2327                logger.warning(
2328                    f"content_embedding inválido para {item.get('id', 'desconhecido')}"
2329                )
2330                valid = False
2331
2332            if not np.all(np.isfinite(item.get("summary_embedding", []))):
2333                logger.warning(
2334                    f"summary_embedding inválido para {item.get('id', 'desconhecido')}"
2335                )
2336                valid = False
2337
2338            # Checa presença de perguntas e respostas
2339            if not item.get("questions"):
2340                logger.warning(
2341                    f"Registro {item.get('id', 'desconhecido')} sem perguntas"
2342                )
2343                valid = False
2344
2345            if not item.get("answers"):
2346                logger.warning(
2347                    f"Registro {item.get('id', 'desconhecido')} sem respostas"
2348                )
2349                valid = False
2350
2351            if "relations" not in item:
2352                logger.warning(
2353                    f"Registro {item.get('id', 'desconhecido')} sem relações"
2354                )
2355                valid = False
2356
2357            # Verifica tamanho do resumo
2358            summary_text = item.get("summary", "")
2359            if len(summary_text) < Config.MIN_TEXT_LENGTH:
2360                logger.warning(
2361                    f"Resumo muito curto para {item.get('id', 'desconhecido')}"
2362                )
2363                valid = False
2364
2365            if valid:
2366                validated_data.append(item)
2367
2368        # Quality metrics
2369        try:
2370            metrics.dataset_completeness.set(
2371                len(validated_data) / len(self.dataset) if self.dataset else 0.0
2372            )
2373            topics = {i.get("topic") for i in validated_data if i.get("topic")}
2374            metrics.dataset_topic_diversity.set(
2375                len(topics) / len(validated_data) if validated_data else 0.0
2376            )
2377        except Exception:  # pragma: no cover - metrics failures
2378            pass
2379
2380        if not validated_data:
2381            logger.warning("Nenhum registro válido para salvar")
2382            return
2383
2384        # Ordena por idioma e tópico
2385        sorted_data = sorted(validated_data, key=lambda x: (x["language"], x["topic"]))
2386
2387        backend = storage.get_backend(Config.STORAGE_BACKEND, output_dir)
2388        backend.save_dataset(sorted_data, format)
2389        logger.info(f"Dataset salvo usando backend {Config.STORAGE_BACKEND}")
2390
2391        if format == "qa":
2392            save_qa_dataset(sorted_data, Path(output_dir) / "qa_pairs.json")
2393        if format == "text":
2394            save_text_corpus(sorted_data, Path(output_dir) / "text_corpus")
2395
2396        if format in ["all", "hf", "tfrecord"]:
2397            try:
2398                hf_dataset = Dataset.from_list(sorted_data)
2399                hf_dataset.save_to_disk(os.path.join(output_dir, "huggingface"))
2400                logger.info(
2401                    f"Dataset salvo para HuggingFace: {os.path.join(output_dir, 'huggingface')}"
2402                )
2403            except Exception as e:
2404                logger.error(f"Erro ao salvar dataset HuggingFace: {e}")
2405
2406        # Write metadata about the dataset
2407        try:
2408            sources = {
2409                item.get("metadata", {}).get("source", "unknown")
2410                for item in sorted_data
2411            }
2412            info = {
2413                "source": list(sources)[0] if len(sources) == 1 else sorted(sources),
2414                "collection_date": datetime.utcnow().date().isoformat(),
2415                "license": "CC BY-SA 4.0",
2416            }
2417            with open(
2418                os.path.join(output_dir, "dataset_info.json"), "w", encoding="utf-8"
2419            ) as f:
2420                json.dump(info, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
2421        except Exception as e:  # pragma: no cover - unexpected I/O errors
2422            logger.error(f"Erro ao salvar dataset_info.json: {e}")
2423
