2425# ============================
2426# 🚦 Pipeline de Execução Principal
2427# ============================
2428def main(
2429    langs: Optional[List[str]] = None,
2430    categories: Optional[List[str]] = None,
2431    fmt: str = "all",
2432    rate_limit_delay: Optional[float] = None,
2433    *,
2434    start_pages: Optional[List[str]] = None,
2435    depth: int = 1,
2436    revisions: bool = False,
2437    rev_limit: int = 5,
2438    client=None,
2439):
2440    """Gera o dataset utilizando os parâmetros fornecidos."""
2441    start_time = time.perf_counter()
2442    metrics.start_metrics_server(int(os.environ.get("METRICS_PORT", "8001")))
2443    logger.info("🚀 Iniciando Wikipedia Scraper Ultra Pro Max - GodMode++")
2444
2445    if rate_limit_delay is not None:
2446        Config.RATE_LIMIT_DELAY = rate_limit_delay
2447        rate_limiter.base_min = rate_limit_delay
2448        rate_limiter.base_max = rate_limit_delay
2449        rate_limiter.reset()
2450
2451    languages = langs or Config.LANGUAGES
2452    cats = Config.CATEGORIES
2453    if categories:
2454        normalized = [normalize_category(c) or c for c in categories]
2455        cats = {c: Config.CATEGORIES.get(c, 1.0) for c in normalized}
2456
2457    builder = DatasetBuilder(include_revisions=revisions, rev_limit=rev_limit)
2458
2459    all_pages: List[dict] = []
2460    for lang in languages:
2461        logger.info(f"🌐 Processando idioma: {lang.upper()}")
2462        wiki = WikipediaAdvanced(lang)
2463
2464        for category, weight in cats.items():
2465            logger.info(f"🔍 Buscando na categoria: {category} (peso: {weight})")
2466
2467            pages = wiki.get_category_members(category)
2468            logger.info(f"📄 Páginas encontradas em {category}: {len(pages)}")
2469
2470            for page in pages:
2471                page["weight"] = weight
2472
2473            all_pages.extend(pages)
2474            time.sleep(Config.RATE_LIMIT_DELAY * 2)
2475
2476        if start_pages:
2477            for sp in start_pages:
2478                logger.info(
2479                    f"🕸️ Rastreiando links a partir de: {sp} (profundidade: {depth})"
2480                )
2481                pages = wiki.crawl_links(sp, depth)
2482                logger.info(f"📄 Páginas coletadas de {sp}: {len(pages)}")
2483                all_pages.extend(pages)
2484                time.sleep(Config.RATE_LIMIT_DELAY * 2)
2485
2486    logger.info(f"📚 Total de páginas coletadas: {len(all_pages)}")
2487
2488    builder.build_from_pages(all_pages, "Construindo dataset", client=client)
2489
2490    logger.info("🧠 Aplicando técnicas avançadas de NLP...")
2491    builder.enhance_with_clustering()
2492
2493    # Carrega dados extras de plugins para completar registros
2494    extra_data: List[dict] = []
2495    try:
2496        from plugins import load_plugin
2497
2498        for plugin_name in [
2499            "stackoverflow",
2500            "wikidata",
2501            "infobox_parser",
2502            "table_parser",
2503        ]:
2504            try:
2505                plugin = load_plugin(plugin_name)
2506            except Exception as e:
2507                logger.error(f"Erro ao carregar plugin {plugin_name}: {e}")
2508                continue
2509            for lang in languages:
2510                for category in cats:
2511                    try:
2512                        items = plugin.fetch_items(lang, category)
2513                        for item in items:
2514                            parsed = plugin.parse_item(item)
2515                            if parsed:
2516                                extra_data.append(parsed)
2517                    except Exception as e:  # pragma: no cover - network errors
2518                        logger.error(f"Erro plugin {plugin_name}: {e}")
2519    except Exception:
2520        pass
2521
2522    # Deduplicação e validação de qualidade
2523    if hasattr(builder, "dataset"):

2525        data, rem_emb = dq.deduplicate_by_embedding(data)
2526        data = dq.complete_missing_fields(data, extra_data)
2527        data, invalid = dq.validate_semantics(data)
2528
2529        builder.duplicates_removed = rem_hash + rem_emb
2530        builder.invalid_records = invalid
2531        builder.dataset = data
2532        if hasattr(builder, "_update_progress"):
2533            builder._update_progress()

2536    builder.save_dataset(format=fmt)

2540    metrics.scrape_session_seconds.observe(time.perf_counter() - start_time)

194def get_next_proxy() -> str | None:
195    """Return the next proxy from ``Config.PROXIES`` cycling sequentially."""
196    global _proxy_index
197    if not Config.PROXIES:
198        return None
199    proxy = Config.PROXIES[_proxy_index % len(Config.PROXIES)]
200    _proxy_index += 1
201    return proxy

215class RateLimiter:
216    """Simple exponential backoff rate limiter with jitter."""
217
218    def __init__(self, min_delay: float, max_delay: float | None = None):
219        if max_delay is None:
220            max_delay = min_delay
221        self.base_min = min_delay
222        self.base_max = max_delay
223        self.min_delay = min_delay
224        self.max_delay = max_delay
225        self.consecutive_failures = 0
226
227    def _sample_delay(self) -> float:
228        return random.uniform(self.min_delay, self.max_delay)
229
230    def wait(self):
231        time.sleep(self._sample_delay())
232
233    async def async_wait(self):
234        await asyncio.sleep(self._sample_delay())
235
236    def record_error(self):
237        self.consecutive_failures += 1
238        self.min_delay *= 2
239        self.max_delay *= 2
240
241    def record_success(self):
242        self.reset()
243
244    def reset(self):
245        self.consecutive_failures = 0
246        self.min_delay = self.base_min
247        self.max_delay = self.base_max

def normalize_category(name: str) -> Optional[str]: 
261def normalize_category(name: str) -> Optional[str]:
262    """Retorna o nome canônico de uma categoria.
263
264    A comparação ignora acentos e diferenças de maiúsculas/minúsculas.
265    Se a categoria ou um de seus aliases for encontrado, devolve o nome
266    oficial; caso contrário, ``None``.
267    """
268
269    normalized = unidecode(name).lower()
270
271    for canonical in Config.CATEGORIES:
272        if unidecode(canonical).lower() == normalized:
273            return canonical
274
275    return CATEGORY_ALIASES.get(normalized)

Retorna o nome canônico de uma categoria.

A comparação ignora acentos e diferenças de maiúsculas/minúsculas. Se a categoria ou um de seus aliases for encontrado, devolve o nome oficial; caso contrário, None.

class CustomFormatter(logging.Formatter): 
281class CustomFormatter(logging.Formatter):
282    grey = "\x1b[38;20m"
283    yellow = "\x1b[33;20m"
284    red = "\x1b[31;20m"
285    bold_red = "\x1b[31;1m"
286    reset = "\x1b[0m"
287    format_str = (
288        "%(asctime)s - %(name)s - %(levelname)s - %(message)s (%(filename)s:%(lineno)d)"
289    )
290
291    FORMATS = {
292        logging.DEBUG: grey + format_str + reset,
293        logging.INFO: grey + format_str + reset,
294        logging.WARNING: yellow + format_str + reset,
295        logging.ERROR: red + format_str + reset,
296        logging.CRITICAL: bold_red + format_str + reset,
297    }
298
299    def format(self, record):
300        log_fmt = self.FORMATS.get(record.levelno)
301        formatter = logging.Formatter(log_fmt)
302        return formatter.format(record)

Formatter instances are used to convert a LogRecord to text.

Formatters need to know how a LogRecord is constructed. They are responsible for converting a LogRecord to (usually) a string which can be interpreted by either a human or an external system. The base Formatter allows a formatting string to be specified. If none is supplied, the style-dependent default value, "%(message)s", "{message}", or "${message}", is used.

The Formatter can be initialized with a format string which makes use of knowledge of the LogRecord attributes - e.g. the default value mentioned above makes use of the fact that the user's message and arguments are pre- formatted into a LogRecord's message attribute. Currently, the useful attributes in a LogRecord are described by:

%(name)s Name of the logger (logging channel) %(levelno)s Numeric logging level for the message (DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL) %(levelname)s Text logging level for the message ("DEBUG", "INFO", "WARNING", "ERROR", "CRITICAL") %(pathname)s Full pathname of the source file where the logging call was issued (if available) %(filename)s Filename portion of pathname %(module)s Module (name portion of filename) %(lineno)d Source line number where the logging call was issued (if available) %(funcName)s Function name %(created)f Time when the LogRecord was created (time.time() return value) %(asctime)s Textual time when the LogRecord was created %(msecs)d Millisecond portion of the creation time %(relativeCreated)d Time in milliseconds when the LogRecord was created, relative to the time the logging module was loaded (typically at application startup time) %(thread)d Thread ID (if available) %(threadName)s Thread name (if available) %(process)d Process ID (if available) %(message)s The result of record.getMessage(), computed just as the record is emitted

grey = '\x1b[38;20m'
yellow = '\x1b[33;20m'
red = '\x1b[31;20m'
bold_red = '\x1b[31;1m'
reset = '\x1b[0m'
format_str = '%(asctime)s - %(name)s - %(levelname)s - %(message)s (%(filename)s:%(lineno)d)'
FORMATS = {10: '\x1b[38;20m%(asctime)s - %(name)s - %(levelname)s - %(message)s (%(filename)s:%(lineno)d)\x1b[0m', 20: '\x1b[38;20m%(asctime)s - %(name)s - %(levelname)s - %(message)s (%(filename)s:%(lineno)d)\x1b[0m', 30: '\x1b[33;20m%(asctime)s - %(name)s - %(levelname)s - %(message)s (%(filename)s:%(lineno)d)\x1b[0m', 40: '\x1b[31;20m%(asctime)s - %(name)s - %(levelname)s - %(message)s (%(filename)s:%(lineno)d)\x1b[0m', 50: '\x1b[31;1m%(asctime)s - %(name)s - %(levelname)s - %(message)s (%(filename)s:%(lineno)d)\x1b[0m'}
def format(self, record): 
299    def format(self, record):
300        log_fmt = self.FORMATS.get(record.levelno)
301        formatter = logging.Formatter(log_fmt)
302        return formatter.format(record)

Format the specified record as text.

The record's attribute dictionary is used as the operand to a string formatting operation which yields the returned string. Before formatting the dictionary, a couple of preparatory steps are carried out. The message attribute of the record is computed using LogRecord.getMessage(). If the formatting string uses the time (as determined by a call to usesTime(), formatTime() is called to format the event time. If there is exception information, it is formatted using formatException() and appended to the message.

class JsonFormatter(logging.Formatter): 
305class JsonFormatter(logging.Formatter):
306    """Simple JSON formatter with standard fields."""
307
308    def format(self, record: logging.LogRecord) -> str:
309        rec = {
310            "timestamp": self.formatTime(record, self.datefmt),
311            "level": record.levelname,
312            "name": record.name,
313            "message": record.getMessage(),
314            "file": record.filename,
315            "line": record.lineno,
316        }

Format the specified record as text.

The record's attribute dictionary is used as the operand to a string formatting operation which yields the returned string. Before formatting the dictionary, a couple of preparatory steps are carried out. The message attribute of the record is computed using LogRecord.getMessage(). If the formatting string uses the time (as determined by a call to usesTime(), formatTime() is called to format the event time. If there is exception information, it is formatted using formatException() and appended to the message.

def setup_logger(name, log_file, level: int = 20, fmt: str = 'text'): 
371def setup_logger(name, log_file, level: int = logging.INFO, fmt: str = "text"):
372    """Configure and return a logger with console and file handlers."""
373    os.makedirs(Config.LOG_DIR, exist_ok=True)
374
375    logger = logging.getLogger(name)
376    logger.setLevel(level)
377    logger.handlers.clear()
378
379    formatter = JsonFormatter() if fmt == "json" else CustomFormatter()
380
381    handler = logging.FileHandler(os.path.join(Config.LOG_DIR, log_file))
382    handler.setFormatter(formatter)
383    logger.addHandler(handler)
384
385    console_handler = logging.StreamHandler()
386    console_handler.setFormatter(formatter)
387    logger.addHandler(console_handler)
388
389    if Config.LOG_SERVICE_URL:
390        if Config.LOG_SERVICE_TYPE == "elastic":
391            remote = ElasticsearchHandler(Config.LOG_SERVICE_URL)
392        else:
393            remote = LokiHandler(Config.LOG_SERVICE_URL)
394        remote.setFormatter(formatter)
395        logger.addHandler(remote)
396
397    return logger

1953def _no_init_or_replace_init(self, *args, **kwargs):
1954    cls = type(self)
1955
1956    if cls._is_protocol:
1957        raise TypeError('Protocols cannot be instantiated')
1958
1959    # Already using a custom `__init__`. No need to calculate correct
1960    # `__init__` to call. This can lead to RecursionError. See bpo-45121.
1961    if cls.__init__ is not _no_init_or_replace_init:
1962        return
1963
1964    # Initially, `__init__` of a protocol subclass is set to `_no_init_or_replace_init`.
1965    # The first instantiation of the subclass will call `_no_init_or_replace_init` which
1966    # searches for a proper new `__init__` in the MRO. The new `__init__`
1967    # replaces the subclass' old `__init__` (ie `_no_init_or_replace_init`). Subsequent
1968    # instantiation of the protocol subclass will thus use the new
1969    # `__init__` and no longer call `_no_init_or_replace_init`.
1970    for base in cls.__mro__:
1971        init = base.__dict__.get('__init__', _no_init_or_replace_init)
1972        if init is not _no_init_or_replace_init:
1973            cls.__init__ = init
1974            break
1975    else:
1976        # should not happen
1977        cls.__init__ = object.__init__
1978
1979    cls.__init__(self, *args, **kwargs)

426class FileCache(CacheBackend):
427    def __init__(self):
428        os.makedirs(Config.CACHE_DIR, exist_ok=True)
429        self.hits = 0
430        self.misses = 0
431
432    def _get_cache_path(self, key: str) -> str:
433        hash_key = hashlib.md5(key.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
434        return os.path.join(Config.CACHE_DIR, f"{hash_key}.pkl.gz")
435
436    @backoff.on_exception(backoff.expo, Exception, max_tries=3)
437    def get(self, key: str):
438        cache_file = self._get_cache_path(key)
439        if os.path.exists(cache_file):
440            try:
441                with open(cache_file, "rb") as f:
442                    compressed_data = f.read()
443                data = pickle.loads(zlib.decompress(compressed_data))
444                self.hits += 1
445                return data
446            except Exception as e:
447                logger.warning(f"Erro ao ler cache {key}: {e}")
448                os.remove(cache_file)
449
450        self.misses += 1
451        return None
452
453    @backoff.on_exception(backoff.expo, Exception, max_tries=3)
454    def set(self, key: str, data, ttl: Optional[int] = None):
455        cache_file = self._get_cache_path(key)
456        try:
457            compressed_data = zlib.compress(pickle.dumps(data))
458            temp_file = cache_file + ".tmp"
459            with open(temp_file, "wb") as f:
460                f.write(compressed_data)
461            os.replace(temp_file, cache_file)
462        except Exception as e:
463            logger.error(f"Erro ao salvar cache {key}: {e}")
464            if os.path.exists(temp_file):
465                os.remove(temp_file)
466
467    def stats(self) -> dict:
468        return {
469            "hits": self.hits,
470            "misses": self.misses,
471            "hit_rate": (
472                self.hits / (self.hits + self.misses)
473                if (self.hits + self.misses) > 0
474                else 0
475            ),
476        }

class RedisCache(CacheBackend): 
479class RedisCache(CacheBackend):
480    def __init__(self, url: str):
481        try:
482            import redis  # type: ignore
483        except Exception as exc:  # pragma: no cover - import error
484            raise ImportError("redis package required for RedisCache") from exc
485
486        self.client = redis.Redis.from_url(url)
487        self.hits = 0
488        self.misses = 0
489
490    def get(self, key: str):
491        val = self.client.get(key)
492        if val is not None:
493            try:
494                data = pickle.loads(zlib.decompress(val))
495            except Exception:
496                self.client.delete(key)
497                self.misses += 1
498                return None
499            self.hits += 1
500            return data
501        self.misses += 1
502        return None
503
504    def set(self, key: str, data, ttl: Optional[int] = None):
505        val = zlib.compress(pickle.dumps(data))
506        if ttl:
507            self.client.setex(key, ttl, val)
508        else:
509            self.client.set(key, val)
510
511    def stats(self) -> dict:
512        return {
513            "hits": self.hits,
514            "misses": self.misses,
515            "hit_rate": (
516                self.hits / (self.hits + self.misses)
517                if (self.hits + self.misses) > 0
518                else 0
519            ),
520        }

class SQLiteCache(CacheBackend): 
523class SQLiteCache(CacheBackend):
524    def __init__(self, path: str):
525        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)
526        self.conn = sqlite3.connect(path, check_same_thread=False)
527        self.conn.execute(
528            "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cache (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value BLOB, expires_at INTEGER)"
529        )
530        self.hits = 0
531        self.misses = 0
532
533    def get(self, key: str):
534        cur = self.conn.execute(
535            "SELECT value, expires_at FROM cache WHERE key=?", (key,)
536        )
537        row = cur.fetchone()
538        if row:
539            value, exp = row
540            if exp is not None and exp < int(time.time()):
541                self.conn.execute("DELETE FROM cache WHERE key=?", (key,))
542                self.conn.commit()
543                self.misses += 1
544                return None
545            try:
546                data = pickle.loads(zlib.decompress(value))
547            except Exception:
548                self.conn.execute("DELETE FROM cache WHERE key=?", (key,))
549                self.conn.commit()
550                self.misses += 1
551                return None
552            self.hits += 1
553            return data
554        self.misses += 1
555        return None
556
557    def set(self, key: str, data, ttl: Optional[int] = None):
558        val = zlib.compress(pickle.dumps(data))
559        exp = int(time.time()) + ttl if ttl else None
560        self.conn.execute(
561            "REPLACE INTO cache (key, value, expires_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
562            (key, val, exp),
563        )
564        self.conn.commit()
565
566    def stats(self) -> dict:
567        return {
568            "hits": self.hits,
569            "misses": self.misses,
570            "hit_rate": (
571                self.hits / (self.hits + self.misses)
572                if (self.hits + self.misses) > 0
573                else 0
574            ),
575        }

589def clear_cache() -> None:
590    """Remove arquivos ou registros expirados do cache."""
591    ttl = Config.CACHE_TTL
592    if Config.CACHE_BACKEND == "sqlite":
593        if not os.path.exists(Config.SQLITE_PATH):
594            return
595        conn = sqlite3.connect(Config.SQLITE_PATH)
596        conn.execute(
597            "DELETE FROM cache WHERE expires_at IS NOT NULL AND expires_at < ?",
598            (int(time.time()),),
599        )
600        conn.commit()
601        conn.close()
602    elif Config.CACHE_BACKEND == "file":
603        if ttl is None:
604            return
605        cutoff = time.time() - ttl
606        path = Path(Config.CACHE_DIR)
607        if path.exists():
608            for p in path.glob("*.pkl.gz"):
609                if p.stat().st_mtime < cutoff:
610                    p.unlink()
611    else:
612        # Redis remove chaves expiradas automaticamente
613        pass

637                        f"Modelo NLP para {lang} não encontrado, tentando modelo pequeno"
638                    )
639                    try:
640                        cls._instances[lang] = spacy.load(
641                            Config.NLP_MODELS[lang].replace("_lg", "_sm")
642                        )
643                    except OSError:
644                        logger.warning(
645                            f"Modelos lg e sm para {lang} indisponíveis, usando 'en_core_web_sm'"
646                        )
647                        cls._instances[lang] = spacy.load("en_core_web_sm")
648            else:
649                logger.warning(f"Modelo NLP para {lang} não configurado, usando inglês")
650                cls._instances[lang] = spacy.load(Config.NLP_MODELS["en"])
651        return cls._instances[lang]

def extract_keywords(text: str, lang: str = 'en', n: int = 10) -> List[str]: 
660def extract_keywords(text: str, lang: str = "en", n: int = 10) -> List[str]:
661    try:
662        nlp = NLPProcessor.get_instance(lang)
663        doc = nlp(text)
664
665        # Filtra substantivos e nomes próprios
666        keywords = [
667            chunk.text for chunk in doc.noun_chunks if len(chunk.text.split()) <= 3
668        ]
669
670        # Remove duplicatas e conta frequência
671        freq = {}
672        for word in keywords:
673            word_lower = word.lower()
674            if word_lower in freq:
675                freq[word_lower] += 1
676            else:
677                freq[word_lower] = 1
678
679        # Ordena por frequência e pega os top N
680        sorted_keywords = sorted(freq.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)
681        return [kw[0] for kw in sorted_keywords[:n]]
682
683    except Exception as e:
684        logger.error(f"Erro ao extrair keywords: {e}")
685        return []
def summarize_text(text: str, lang: str = 'en') -> str: 
688def summarize_text(text: str, lang: str = "en") -> str:
689    try:
690        parser = PlaintextParser.from_string(text, Tokenizer(lang))
691        summarizer = LsaSummarizer()
692        summary = summarizer(parser.document, Config.SUMMARY_SENTENCES)
693        return " ".join([str(sentence) for sentence in summary])
694    except Exception as e:
695        logger.error(f"Erro ao sumarizar texto: {e}")
696        return (
697            text[: Config.MIN_TEXT_LENGTH]
698            if len(text) > Config.MIN_TEXT_LENGTH
699            else text
700        )
def cluster_texts(texts: List[str], k: int = 10) -> numpy.ndarray: 
703def cluster_texts(texts: List[str], k: int = Config.CLUSTER_K) -> np.ndarray:
704    try:
705        model = NLPProcessor.get_embedding_model()
706        embeddings = model.encode(texts, show_progress_bar=False)
707
708        # Normaliza os embeddings
709        norms = np.linalg.norm(embeddings, axis=1, keepdims=True)
710        normalized_embeddings = embeddings / norms
711
712        # Clusteriza usando K-means
713        kmeans = KMeans(n_clusters=k, random_state=42)
714        clusters = kmeans.fit_predict(normalized_embeddings)
715
716        return clusters
717    except Exception as e:
718        logger.error(f"Erro no clustering: {e}")
719        return np.zeros(len(texts))
def advanced_clean_text( text: str, lang: str = 'en', remove_stopwords: bool = False, split: bool = False, stem: bool = False) -> str | list[str]: 
725def advanced_clean_text(
726    text: str,
727    lang: str = "en",
728    remove_stopwords: bool = False,
729    split: bool = False,
730    stem: bool = False,
731) -> str | list[str]:
732    """Clean wiki text with optional stopword removal, stemming and sentence splitting."""
733    try:
734        text = clean_wiki_text(text)
735
736        # Remove caracteres especiais, mantendo acentos quando relevante
737        if lang in ["en", "de"]:
738            text = unidecode(text)
739
740        # Remove padrões específicos da Wikipedia
741        text = re.sub(r"\[\d+\]", "", text)  # Referências [1], [2], etc.
742        text = re.sub(
743            r"\b(ver também|see also|véase también|voir aussi)\b.*",
744            "",
745            text,
746            flags=re.IGNORECASE,
747        )
748        text = re.sub(r"\{\|.*?\|\}", "", text, flags=re.DOTALL)  # Remove tables
749
750        # Remove seções específicas
751        sections_to_remove = [
752            "referências",
753            "references",
754            "referencias",
755            "bibliografia",
756            "bibliography",
757            "bibliografía",
758            "ligações externas",
759            "external links",
760            "enlaces externos",
761        ]
762        for section in sections_to_remove:
763            text = re.sub(
764                rf"==\s*{section}\s*==.*", "", text, flags=re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL
765            )
766
767        if remove_stopwords or stem:
768            removed = False
769            try:
770                nlp = NLPProcessor.get_instance(lang)
771                doc = nlp(text)
772                tokens = []
773                for t in doc:
774                    if remove_stopwords and getattr(t, "is_stop", False):
775                        continue
776                    tokens.append(t.lemma_ if stem else t.text)
777                text = " ".join(tokens)
778                removed = True
779            except Exception as e:
780                logger.error(f"Erro ao processar texto com spaCy: {e}")
781            if not removed:
782                try:
783                    import nltk
784                    from nltk.corpus import stopwords
785                    from nltk.stem import SnowballStemmer, PorterStemmer
786
787                    stop_words = set()
788                    if remove_stopwords:
789                        stop_words = set(stopwords.words(lang))
790                    if stem:
791                        try:
792                            stemmer = SnowballStemmer(lang)
793                        except Exception:
794                            stemmer = PorterStemmer()
795                    tokens = []
796                    for w in text.split():
797                        if remove_stopwords and w.lower() in stop_words:
798                            continue
799                        if stem:
800                            tokens.append(stemmer.stem(w))
801                        else:
802                            tokens.append(w)
803                    text = " ".join(tokens)
804                except Exception as e:
805                    logger.error(f"Erro ao processar texto com NLTK: {e}")
806
807        text = text.strip()
808        if split:
809            return split_sentences(text, lang)
810        return text
811    except Exception as e:
812        logger.error(f"Erro na limpeza de texto: {e}")
813        return text

Clean wiki text with optional stopword removal, stemming and sentence splitting.

def extract_infobox(html: str) -> Dict[str, str]: 
860def extract_infobox(html: str) -> Dict[str, str]:
861    """Return a dictionary with key/value pairs from the first infobox table."""
862    try:
863        soup = BeautifulSoup(html, "html.parser")
864        box = soup.find("table", class_=lambda c: c and "infobox" in c)
865        if not box:
866            return {}
867        data: Dict[str, str] = {}
868        for row in box.find_all("tr"):
869            header = row.find("th")
870            value = row.find("td")
871            if header and value:
872                key = header.get_text(strip=True)
873                val = value.get_text(strip=True)
874                data[key] = val
875        return data
876    except Exception as e:
877        logger.error(f"Erro ao extrair infobox: {e}")
878        return {}

Return a dictionary with key/value pairs from the first infobox table.

881def extract_tables(html: str) -> List[List[List[str]]]:
882    """Return all HTML tables as lists of rows and cells."""

def extract_images(html: str) -> List[Dict[str, str]]: 
900def extract_images(html: str) -> List[Dict[str, str]]:
901    """Return image URLs and captions from thumbnail/figure elements."""
902    try:
903        soup = BeautifulSoup(html, "html.parser")
904        results: List[Dict[str, str]] = []
905
906        for div in soup.find_all("div", class_=lambda c: c and "thumb" in c.split()):
907            img = div.find("img")
908            if not img or not img.get("src"):
909                continue
910            url = img["src"]
911            if url.startswith("//"):
912                url = "https:" + url
913            caption_tag = div.find(class_="thumbcaption")
914            caption = caption_tag.get_text(strip=True) if caption_tag else ""
915            results.append({"image_url": url, "caption": caption})
916
917        for fig in soup.find_all("figure"):
918            img = fig.find("img")
919            if not img or not img.get("src"):
920                continue
921            url = img["src"]
922            if url.startswith("//"):
923                url = "https:" + url
924            caption_tag = fig.find("figcaption")
925            caption = caption_tag.get_text(strip=True) if caption_tag else ""
926            results.append({"image_url": url, "caption": caption})
927
928        return results
929    except Exception as e:
930        logger.error(f"Erro ao extrair imagens: {e}")
931        return []

Return image URLs and captions from thumbnail/figure elements.

async def fetch_with_retry( url: str, *, params: dict | None = None, headers: dict | None = None, retries: int = 5, proxy: str | None = None) -> tuple[int, str]: 
 934async def fetch_with_retry(
 935    url: str,
 936    *,
 937    params: dict | None = None,
 938    headers: dict | None = None,
 939    retries: int = Config.RETRIES,
 940    proxy: str | None = None,
 941) -> tuple[int, str]:
 942    """Fetch a URL using ``aiohttp`` with automatic retries and logging."""
 943
 944    if proxy is None and Config.PROXIES:
 945        proxy = get_next_proxy()
 946
 947    for attempt in range(1, retries + 1):
 948        try:
 949            timeout = aiohttp.ClientTimeout(total=Config.TIMEOUT)
 950            acquired_dummy = False
 951            if (
 952                hasattr(fetch_semaphore, "active")
 953                and hasattr(fetch_semaphore, "limit")
 954                and not hasattr(fetch_semaphore, "acquire")
 955            ):
 956                while fetch_semaphore.active >= fetch_semaphore.limit:
 957                    await asyncio.sleep(0)
 958                await fetch_semaphore.__aenter__()
 959                acquired_dummy = True
 960            else:
 961                await fetch_semaphore.acquire()
 962            try:
 963                async with aiohttp.ClientSession(timeout=timeout) as session:
 964                    async with session.get(
 965                        url, params=params, headers=headers, proxy=proxy
 966                    ) as resp:
 967                        if resp.status == 429:
 968                            metrics.scrape_block.inc()
 969                        if 500 <= resp.status < 600:
 970                            raise aiohttp.ClientResponseError(
 971                                resp.request_info,
 972                                resp.history,
 973                                status=resp.status,
 974                                message=resp.reason,
 975                                headers=resp.headers,
 976                            )
 977                        resp.raise_for_status()
 978                        rate_limiter.record_success()
 979                        return resp.status, await resp.text()
 980            finally:
 981                if acquired_dummy:
 982                    await fetch_semaphore.__aexit__(None, None, None)
 983                else:
 984                    fetch_semaphore.release()
 985        except aiohttp.ClientResponseError as e:
 986            if getattr(e, "status", None) == 429:
 987                logger.warning(f"HTTP 429 for {url}, backing off")
 988                rate_limiter.record_error()
 989            else:
 990                logger.warning(f"Attempt {attempt} failed for {url}: {e}")
 991            exc = e
 992        except asyncio.TimeoutError as e:
 993            logger.warning(f"Timeout while fetching {url}")
 994            rate_limiter.record_error()
 995            exc = e
 996        except Exception as e:
 997            logger.warning(f"Attempt {attempt} failed for {url}: {e}")
 998            exc = e
 999        if attempt < retries:
1000            metrics.request_retries_total.inc()
1001            await asyncio.sleep(2)
1002        else:
1003            log_failed_url(url)
1004            metrics.requests_failed_total.inc()
1005            raise exc

Fetch a URL using aiohttp with automatic retries and logging.

def search_category(keyword: str, lang: str) -> Optional[str]: 
1042def search_category(keyword: str, lang: str) -> Optional[str]:
1043    """Search for a similar category name using the Wikipedia API."""
1044    cache_key = f"search_category_{lang}_{keyword}"
1045    cached = cache.get(cache_key)
1046    if cached is not None:
1047        return cached
1048
1049    url = f"{get_base_url(lang)}/w/api.php"
1050    params = {
1051        "action": "query",
1052        "list": "search",
1053        "srnamespace": 14,
1054        "srsearch": keyword,
1055        "format": "json",
1056    }
1057
1058    async def _async_search() -> Optional[str]:
1059        await rate_limiter.async_wait()
1060        status, text = await fetch_with_retry(
1061            url, params=params, headers={"User-Agent": Config.get_random_user_agent()}
1062        )
1063        if status == 429:
1064            rate_limiter.record_error()
1065        data = json.loads(text)
1066        results = data.get("query", {}).get("search", [])
1067        if results:
1068            title = results[0].get("title", "")
1069            title = title.replace("Category:", "").replace("Categoria:", "")
1070            cache.set(cache_key, title, ttl=Config.CACHE_TTL)
1071            return title
1072        return None
1073
1074    try:
1075        return asyncio.run(_async_search()) or cache.get(cache_key)
1076    except Exception as e:  # pragma: no cover - network issues
1077        rate_limiter.record_error()
1078        logger.error(f"Erro ao buscar categorias para {keyword}: {e}")
1079        return cache.get(cache_key)

Search for a similar category name using the Wikipedia API.

def get_revision_history(title: str, lang: str, limit: int) -> List[dict]: 
1082def get_revision_history(title: str, lang: str, limit: int) -> List[dict]:
1083    """Return revision metadata for a page using the Wikipedia API."""
1084
1085    cache_key = f"revisions_{lang}_{title}_{limit}"
1086    cached = cache.get(cache_key)
1087    if cached is not None:
1088        return cached
1089
1090    url = f"{get_base_url(lang)}/w/api.php"
1091    params = {
1092        "action": "query",
1093        "prop": "revisions",
1094        "titles": title,
1095        "rvlimit": limit,
1096        "rvprop": "timestamp|user",
1097        "format": "json",
1098    }
1099
1100    @backoff.on_exception(
1101        backoff.expo,
1102        requests.exceptions.RequestException,
1103        max_tries=Config.RETRIES,
1104    )
1105    def _request() -> List[dict]:
1106        rate_limiter.wait()
1107        resp = requests.get(
1108            url,
1109            params=params,
1110            headers={"User-Agent": Config.get_random_user_agent()},
1111            timeout=Config.TIMEOUT,
1112        )
1113        resp.raise_for_status()
1114        data = resp.json()
1115        pages = data.get("query", {}).get("pages", {})
1116        revs: List[dict] = []
1117        for page in pages.values():
1118            for rev in page.get("revisions", []):
1119                revs.append(
1120                    {
1121                        "timestamp": rev.get("timestamp"),
1122                        "user": rev.get("user"),
1123                    }
1124                )
1125        return revs
1126
1127    try:
1128        revisions = _request()
1129        cache.set(cache_key, revisions, ttl=Config.CACHE_TTL)
1130        return revisions
1131    except Exception as e:  # pragma: no cover - network issues
1132        logger.error(f"Erro ao buscar revisões de {title}: {e}")
1133        fallback = cache.get(cache_key)
1134        if fallback is not None:
1135            return fallback
1136        return []

Return revision metadata for a page using the Wikipedia API.

class WikipediaAdvanced: 
1142class WikipediaAdvanced:
1143    def __init__(self, lang: str):
1144        self.lang = lang
1145        self.wiki = wikipediaapi.Wikipedia(
1146            language=lang,
1147            extract_format=wikipediaapi.ExtractFormat.HTML,
1148            user_agent=Config.get_random_user_agent(),
1149        )
1150        self.session = requests.Session()
1151        self.session.headers.update({"User-Agent": Config.get_random_user_agent()})
1152
1153    def _prepare_session(self):
1154        """Refresh User-Agent and proxy settings before a request."""
1155        self.session.headers["User-Agent"] = Config.get_random_user_agent()
1156        if Config.PROXIES:
1157            self.session.proxies = get_next_proxy()
1158        else:
1159            self.session.proxies = {}
1160
1161    @backoff.on_exception(
1162        backoff.expo,
1163        (requests.exceptions.RequestException, wikipediaapi.WikipediaException),
1164        max_tries=Config.RETRIES,
1165    )
1166    def fetch_page(self, page_title: str) -> Optional[wikipediaapi.WikipediaPage]:
1167        cache_key = f"page_{self.lang}_{page_title}"
1168        cached = cache.get(cache_key)
1169        if cached is not None:
1170            return cached
1171
1172        self._prepare_session()
1173        rate_limiter.wait()
1174
1175        try:
1176            page = self.wiki.page(page_title)
1177            if page.exists():
1178                # Melhora a qualidade do conteúdo
1179                page._fullurl = self.wiki.api.article_url(page_title)
1180                rate_limiter.wait()
1181                page._html = fetch_html_content(page_title, self.lang)
1182                page._html = extract_main_content(page._html)
1183
1184                cache.set(cache_key, page, ttl=Config.CACHE_TTL)
1185                return page
1186        except Exception as e:
1187            rate_limiter.record_error()
1188            logger.error(f"Erro ao buscar página {page_title}: {e}")
1189            log_failed_url(self.wiki.api.article_url(page_title))
1190            raise
1191
1192        return None
1193
1194    async def fetch_page_async(
1195        self, page_title: str
1196    ) -> Optional[wikipediaapi.WikipediaPage]:
1197        """Asynchronous version of :meth:`fetch_page` using ``aiohttp``."""
1198        cache_key = f"page_{self.lang}_{page_title}"
1199        cached = cache.get(cache_key)
1200        if cached is not None:
1201            return cached
1202
1203        await rate_limiter.async_wait()
1204
1205        try:
1206            page = await asyncio.to_thread(self.wiki.page, page_title)
1207            if page.exists():
1208                page._fullurl = self.wiki.api.article_url(page_title)
1209                await rate_limiter.async_wait()
1210                page._html = await fetch_html_content_async(page_title, self.lang)
1211                page._html = extract_main_content(page._html)
1212                cache.set(cache_key, page, ttl=Config.CACHE_TTL)
1213                return page
1214        except Exception as e:
1215            rate_limiter.record_error()
1216            logger.error(f"Erro ao buscar página {page_title}: {e}")
1217            log_failed_url(self.wiki.api.article_url(page_title))
1218            raise
1219
1220        return None
1221
1222    @backoff.on_exception(
1223        backoff.expo,
1224        (requests.exceptions.RequestException, wikipediaapi.WikipediaException),
1225        max_tries=Config.RETRIES,
1226    )
1227    def fetch_category(
1228        self, category_name: str
1229    ) -> Optional[wikipediaapi.WikipediaPage]:
1230        category_title = (
1231            f"Category:{category_name}"
1232            if self.lang != "pt"

1234        )

1307    def get_category_members(
1308        self, category_name: str, depth: int = 0, visited: Optional[Set[str]] = None
1309    ) -> List[dict]:
1310        if visited is None:
1311            visited = set()
1312
1313        category = self.fetch_category(category_name)
1314        if not category or not category.exists():
1315            alt = search_category(category_name, self.lang)
1316            if alt:
1317                category_name = alt
1318                category = self.fetch_category(category_name)
1319
1320        if not category or not category.exists():
1321            logger.warning(f"Categoria não encontrada: {category_name}")
1322            return []
1323
1324        members = []
1325        for member in category.categorymembers.values():
1326            if member.title not in visited:
1327                visited.add(member.title)
1328
1329                if (
1330                    member.ns == wikipediaapi.Namespace.CATEGORY
1331                    and depth < Config.MAX_DEPTH
1332                ):
1333                    sub_members = self.get_category_members(
1334                        member.title.replace("Category:", "").replace("Categoria:", ""),
1335                        depth + 1,
1336                        visited,
1337                    )
1338                    members.extend(sub_members)
1339                elif member.ns == wikipediaapi.Namespace.MAIN:
1340                    members.append(
1341                        {
1342                            "title": member.title,
1343                            "url": member.fullurl,
1344                            "lang": self.lang,
1345                            "category": category_name,
1346                            "depth": depth,
1347                        }
1348                    )
1349
1350                if len(members) >= Config.MAX_PAGES_PER_CATEGORY:
1351                    break
1352
1353        return members

1355    async def get_category_members_async(
1356        self,
1357        category_name: str,
1358        depth: int = 0,
1359        visited: Optional[Set[str]] = None,
1360        max_concurrency: Optional[int] = None,
1361    ) -> List[dict]:
1362        """Asynchronously fetch category members recursively."""
1363        if visited is None:
1364            visited = set()
1365
1366        max_concurrency = max_concurrency or Config.MAX_CONCURRENT_REQUESTS
1367        sem = asyncio.Semaphore(max_concurrency)
1368
1369        category = await asyncio.to_thread(self.fetch_category, category_name)
1370        if not category or not category.exists():
1371            alt = search_category(category_name, self.lang)
1372            if alt:
1373                category_name = alt
1374                category = await asyncio.to_thread(self.fetch_category, category_name)
1375
1376        if not category or not category.exists():
1377            logger.warning(f"Categoria não encontrada: {category_name}")
1378            return []
1379
1380        members: List[dict] = []
1381
1382        async def handle_member(member):
1383            if member.title in visited:
1384                return []
1385            visited.add(member.title)
1386
1387            if (
1388                member.ns == wikipediaapi.Namespace.CATEGORY
1389                and depth < Config.MAX_DEPTH
1390            ):
1391                async with sem:
1392                    return await self.get_category_members_async(
1393                        member.title.replace("Category:", "").replace("Categoria:", ""),
1394                        depth + 1,
1395                        visited,
1396                        max_concurrency,
1397                    )
1398            elif member.ns == wikipediaapi.Namespace.MAIN:
1399                return [
1400                    {
1401                        "title": member.title,
1402                        "url": member.fullurl,
1403                        "lang": self.lang,
1404                        "category": category_name,
1405                        "depth": depth,
1406                    }
1407                ]
1408            return []
1409
1410        tasks = [handle_member(m) for m in category.categorymembers.values()]
1411        for res in await asyncio.gather(*tasks):
1412            members.extend(res)
1413            if len(members) >= Config.MAX_PAGES_PER_CATEGORY:
1414                break
1415
1416        return members

1418    def crawl_links(
1419        self,
1420        start_page: str,
1421        depth: int = 1,
1422        visited: Optional[Set[str]] = None,
1423    ) -> List[dict]:
1424        """Breadth-first crawl of ``/wiki/`` links starting from ``start_page``.
1425
1426        Parameters
1427        ----------
1428        start_page: str
1429            Title of the initial page to crawl.
1430        depth: int
1431            Maximum link depth to follow.
1432        visited: Optional[Set[str]]
1433            Optional set of already visited titles to avoid repeats.
1434
1435        Returns
1436        -------
1437        List[dict]
1438            List of pages in the same format as :meth:`get_category_members`.
1439        """
1440        if visited is None:
1441            visited = set()
1442
1443        queue: List[Tuple[str, int]] = [(start_page, 0)]
1444        results: List[dict] = []
1445        base_url = get_base_url(self.lang)
1446
1447        while queue and len(results) < Config.MAX_PAGES_PER_CATEGORY:
1448            current, cur_depth = queue.pop(0)
1449            if current in visited:
1450                continue
1451            visited.add(current)
1452
1453            try:
1454                html = fetch_html_content(current, self.lang)
1455                links = extract_links(html, base_url)
1456            except Exception as e:
1457                logger.error(f"Erro ao rastrear links de {current}: {e}")
1458                continue
1459
1460            for link in links:
1461                if len(results) >= Config.MAX_PAGES_PER_CATEGORY:
1462                    break
1463                parsed = urlparse(link)
1464                if "/wiki/" not in parsed.path:
1465                    continue
1466                title = parsed.path.split("/wiki/")[-1]
1467                title = requests.utils.unquote(title).replace("_", " ")
1468                if title in visited:
1469                    continue
1470                results.append(
1471                    {
1472                        "title": title,
1473                        "url": link,
1474                        "lang": self.lang,
1475                        "category": start_page,
1476                        "depth": cur_depth,
1477                    }
1478                )
1479                if cur_depth < depth:
1480                    queue.append((title, cur_depth + 1))
1481
1482        return results
1483

1488        visited: Optional[Set[str]] = None,
1489    ) -> List[dict]:
1490        """Asynchronous version of :meth:`crawl_links`."""
1491
1492        if visited is None:
1493            visited = set()
1494
1495        queue: List[Tuple[str, int]] = [(start_page, 0)]
1496        results: List[dict] = []
1497        base_url = get_base_url(self.lang)
1498
1499        while queue and len(results) < Config.MAX_PAGES_PER_CATEGORY:
1500            current, cur_depth = queue.pop(0)
1501            if current in visited:
1502                continue
1503            visited.add(current)
1504
1505            try:
1506                html = await fetch_html_content_async(current, self.lang)
1507                links = extract_links(html, base_url)
1508            except Exception as e:
1509                logger.error(f"Erro ao rastrear links de {current}: {e}")
1510                continue
1511
1512            for link in links:
1513                if len(results) >= Config.MAX_PAGES_PER_CATEGORY:
1514                    break
1515                parsed = urlparse(link)
1516                if "/wiki/" not in parsed.path:
1517                    continue
1518                title = parsed.path.split("/wiki/")[-1]
1519                title = requests.utils.unquote(title).replace("_", " ")
1520                if title in visited:
1521                    continue
1522                results.append(
1523                    {
1524                        "title": title,
1525                        "url": link,
1526                        "lang": self.lang,
1527                        "category": start_page,
1528                        "depth": cur_depth,
1529                    }
1530                )
1531                if cur_depth < depth:
1532                    queue.append((title, cur_depth + 1))
1533
1534        return results

Asynchronous version of crawl_links().

def cpu_process_page( title: str, content: str, lang: str, category: str, images: Optional[List[Dict[str, str]]] = None, revisions: Optional[List[dict]] = None, rev_limit: int = 5) -> dict: 
1542def cpu_process_page(
1543    title: str,
1544    content: str,
1545    lang: str,
1546    category: str,
1547    images: List[Dict[str, str]] | None = None,
1548    revisions: List[dict] | None = None,
1549    rev_limit: int = 5,
1550) -> dict:
1551    """Executes CPU intensive operations for a page."""
1552    builder = DatasetBuilder(include_revisions=revisions, rev_limit=rev_limit)
1553    summary = summarize_text(content, lang)
1554    record = builder.generate_qa_pairs(
1555        title=title,
1556        content=content,
1557        summary=summary,
1558        lang=lang,
1559        category=category,
1560    )
1561    record["entities"] = extract_entities(content)
1562    if images is not None:
1563        record["images"] = images
1564    if revisions is not None:
1565        record.setdefault("metadata", {})["revisions"] = revisions
1566    return record

Executes CPU intensive operations for a page.

1658    def process_page(
1659        self, page_info: dict, proc_executor: Optional[ProcessPoolExecutor] = None
1660    ) -> Optional[object]:
1661        start_time = time.perf_counter()
1662        try:
1663            wiki = WikipediaAdvanced(page_info["lang"])
1664            page = wiki.fetch_page(page_info["title"])
1665
1666            if not page or not page.exists():
1667                return None
1668
1669            # Extrai e limpa o texto
1670            raw_text = clean_text(page.text)
1671            clean_content = advanced_clean_text(
1672                raw_text,
1673                page_info["lang"],
1674                remove_stopwords=Config.REMOVE_STOPWORDS,
1675            )
1676
1677            if len(clean_content) < Config.MIN_TEXT_LENGTH:
1678                return None
1679
1680            if proc_executor:
1681                images = extract_images(getattr(page, "_html", ""))
1682                revisions = None
1683                if self.include_revisions:
1684                    revisions = wiki.get_revision_history(
1685                        page_info["title"], self.rev_limit
1686                    )
1687                return proc_executor.submit(
1688                    cpu_process_page,
1689                    page_info["title"],
1690                    clean_content,
1691                    page_info["lang"],
1692                    page_info.get("category", ""),
1693                    images,
1694                    revisions,
1695                    self.rev_limit,
1696                )
1697
1698            # Sumariza o conteúdo
1699            summary = summarize_text(clean_content, page_info["lang"])
1700
1701            # Gera QA pairs avançadas
1702            qa_data = self.generate_qa_pairs(
1703                title=page_info["title"],
1704                content=clean_content,
1705                summary=summary,
1706                lang=page_info["lang"],
1707                category=page_info.get("category", ""),
1708            )
1709            qa_data["entities"] = extract_entities(clean_content)
1710            images = extract_images(getattr(page, "_html", ""))
1711            qa_data["images"] = images
1712            if self.include_revisions:
1713                qa_data.setdefault("metadata", {})["revisions"] = (
1714                    wiki.get_revision_history(page_info["title"], self.rev_limit)
1715                )
1716            metrics.scrape_success.inc()
1717            metrics.pages_scraped_total.inc()
1718            return qa_data
1719        except Exception as e:
1720            metrics.scrape_error.inc()
1721            logger.error(f"Erro ao processar página {page_info.get('title', '')}: {e}")
1722            return None
1723        finally:
1724            metrics.page_processing_seconds.observe(time.perf_counter() - start_time)
1725
1726    async def process_page_async(
1727        self, page_info: dict, proc_executor: Optional[ProcessPoolExecutor] = None
1728    ) -> Optional[object]:
1729        """Asynchronous wrapper for :meth:`process_page`."""
1730        return await asyncio.to_thread(self.process_page, page_info, proc_executor)

1732    def generate_qa_pairs(
1733        self,
1734        title: str,
1735        content: str,
1736        summary: str,
1737        lang: str,
1738        category: str,
1739        extra_metadata: dict | None = None,
1740    ) -> dict:
1741        raw_code = content
1742        code_lang = detect_programming_language(content)
1743        complexities = {}
1744        docstring = ""
1745        signature = ""
1746        problems: list[str] = []
1747        fixed_version = content
1748        if code_lang != "unknown":
1749            signature = parse_function_signature(content)
1750            try:
1751                tree = ast.parse(content)
1752                func = next(
1753                    (
1754                        n
1755                        for n in tree.body
1756                        if isinstance(n, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef))
1757                    ),
1758                    None,
1759                )
1760                if func:
1761                    ds = ast.get_docstring(func)
1762                    if ds:
1763                        docstring = docstring_to_google(ds)
1764            except Exception:
1765                pass
1766            content = normalize_indentation(remove_comments(content, code_lang))
1767            complexities = get_functions_complexity(content, code_lang)
1768            problems, fixed_version = scan_code(content)
1769            if self.min_complexity is not None and complexities:
1770                if max(complexities.values()) < self.min_complexity:
1771                    return {}
1772            if self.max_complexity is not None and complexities:
1773                if max(complexities.values()) > self.max_complexity:
1774                    return {}
1775        else:
1776            problems, fixed_version = scan_code(content)
1777
1778        # Extrai keywords para gerar perguntas variadas
1779        keywords = extract_keywords(content, lang)
1780
1781        tags = self._extract_tags(keywords, extra_metadata)
1782
1783        # Gera múltiplas perguntas baseadas no conteúdo
1784        questions = self._generate_questions(title, content, lang, keywords)
1785
1786        # Gera respostas completas
1787        answers = self._generate_answers(content, summary, lang)
1788
1789        # Relações semânticas básicas
1790        relations = extract_relations(content, lang)
1791        relations_regex = extract_relations_regex(content)
1792        relations.extend(r for r in relations_regex if r not in relations)
1793
1794        # Cria embeddings para busca semântica
1795        content_embedding = self.embedding_model.encode(
1796            content, show_progress_bar=False
1797        )
1798        summary_embedding = self.embedding_model.encode(
1799            summary, show_progress_bar=False
1800        )
1801
1802        # Classificação avançada de tópicos
1803        topic, subtopic = self._classify_topic(title, content, lang)
1804
1805        record = {
1806            "id": hashlib.md5(f"{title}_{lang}".encode("utf-8")).hexdigest(),
1807            "title": title,
1808            "language": lang,
1809            "category": category,
1810            "topic": topic,
1811            "subtopic": subtopic,
1812            "keywords": keywords,
1813            "tags": tags,
1814            "content": content,
1815            "raw_code": raw_code if code_lang != "unknown" else "",
1816            "summary": summary,
1817            "context": summary,
1818            "problems": problems,
1819            "fixed_version": fixed_version,
1820            "lessons": extra_metadata.get("lessons", "") if extra_metadata else "",
1821            "origin_metrics": (
1822                extra_metadata.get("origin_metrics", {}) if extra_metadata else {}
1823            ),
1824            "challenge": (extra_metadata.get("challenge") if extra_metadata else None)
1825            or generate_challenge_prompt(problems),
1826            "content_embedding": content_embedding.tolist(),
1827            "summary_embedding": summary_embedding.tolist(),
1828            "quality_score": (
1829                extra_metadata.get("quality_score", 0.0) if extra_metadata else 0.0
1830            ),
1831            "quality": None,
1832            "reason": "",
1833            "questions": questions,
1834            "answers": answers,
1835            "relations": relations,
1836            "tests": extra_metadata.get("tests", []) if extra_metadata else [],
1837            "docstring": docstring,
1838            "created_at": datetime.utcnow().isoformat(),
1839            "metadata": {
1840                "length": len(content),
1841                "source": "wikipedia",
1842                "source_url": f"{get_base_url(lang)}/wiki/{title.replace(' ', '_')}",
1843            },
1844        }
1845
1846        # Determine quality classification when possible
1847        if extra_metadata:
1848            if any(
1849                k in extra_metadata for k in ["stars", "stargazers_count", "repository"]
1850            ):
1851                q, r = classify_github_repo(extra_metadata)
1852                record["quality"], record["reason"] = q, r
1853            elif "score" in extra_metadata:
1854                q, r = classify_stackoverflow_answer(extra_metadata)
1855                record["quality"], record["reason"] = q, r
1856        if record["quality"] is None:
1857            score = record.get("quality_score", 0.0)
1858            if score >= 5:
1859                record["quality"] = "high"
1860            elif score >= 2:
1861                record["quality"] = "medium"
1862            else:
1863                record["quality"] = "low"
1864            record["reason"] = "quality score"
1865        if code_lang != "unknown":
1866            record["metadata"]["code_language"] = code_lang
1867            if complexities:
1868                record["metadata"]["complexities"] = complexities
1869            if docstring:
1870                record["docstring"] = docstring
1871            if signature:
1872                record["signature"] = signature
1873        if extra_metadata:
1874            if "wikidata_id" in extra_metadata:
1875                record["wikidata_id"] = extra_metadata["wikidata_id"]
1876            if "image_url" in extra_metadata:
1877                record["image_url"] = extra_metadata["image_url"]
1878        try:
1879            storage_sqlite.save_to_db(
1880                {"id": record["id"], "metadata": record.get("metadata", {})}
1881            )
1882        except Exception as e:
1883            logger.error(f"Erro ao salvar no SQLite: {e}")
1884        return record
1885
1886    def _generate_questions(
1887        self, title: str, content: str, lang: str, keywords: List[str]
1888    ) -> List[dict]:
1889        questions = []
1890
1891        # Pergunta básica sobre o título
1892        base_question = {
1893            "text": self._translate_question(f"What is {title}?", lang),
1894            "type": "definition",
1895            "difficulty": "easy",
1896        }
1897        questions.append(base_question)
1898
1899        # Perguntas baseadas em keywords
1900        for keyword in keywords[:5]:  # Limita a 5 perguntas por keyword
1901            question_types = [
1902                (f"How does {keyword} relate to {title}?", "relation", "medium"),
1903                (f"What is the role of {keyword} in {title}?", "role", "medium"),
1904                (
1905                    f"Can you explain {keyword} in the context of {title}?",
1906                    "explanation",
1907                    "hard",
1908                ),
1909            ]
1910
1911            for q_text, q_type, q_diff in question_types:
1912                questions.append(
1913                    {
1914                        "text": self._translate_question(q_text, lang),
1915                        "type": q_type,
1916                        "difficulty": q_diff,
1917                    }
1918                )
1919
1920        # Perguntas baseadas em conteúdo (usando NLP)
1921        try:
1922            nlp = NLPProcessor.get_instance(lang)
1923            doc = nlp(content)
1924
1925            # Perguntas sobre entidades nomeadas
1926            for ent in doc.ents[:5]:  # Limita a 5 entidades
1927                if ent.label_ in ["PERSON", "ORG", "LOC", "PRODUCT"]:
1928                    questions.append(
1929                        {
1930                            "text": self._translate_question(
1931                                f"What is the significance of {ent.text} in {title}?",
1932                                lang,
1933                            ),
1934                            "type": "significance",
1935                            "difficulty": "medium",
1936                        }
1937                    )
1938
1939            # Perguntas sobre verbos/ações
1940            for sent in doc.sents[:3]:  # Analisa as primeiras 3 sentenças
1941                root = [token for token in sent if token.dep_ == "ROOT"]
1942                if root:
1943                    verb = root[0].lemma_
1944                    questions.append(
1945                        {
1946                            "text": self._translate_question(
1947                                f"How does {title} {verb}?", lang
1948                            ),
1949                            "type": "process",
1950                            "difficulty": "hard",
1951                        }
1952                    )
1953        except Exception as e:
1954            logger.error(f"Erro ao gerar perguntas NLP para {title}: {e}")
1955
1956        return questions
1957
1958    def _generate_answers(self, content: str, summary: str, lang: str) -> List[dict]:
1959        answers = []
1960
1961        # Resposta resumida
1962        answers.append({"text": summary, "type": "summary", "length": "short"})
1963
1964        # Resposta completa
1965        answers.append(
1966            {
1967                "text": content[: Config.MAX_TEXT_LENGTH],  # Limita o tamanho
1968                "type": "detailed",
1969                "length": "long",
1970            }
1971        )
1972
1973        # Respostas específicas por parágrafo
1974        paragraphs = [p for p in content.split("\n") if len(p.strip()) > 0]
1975        for para in paragraphs[:3]:  # Limita a 3 parágrafos
1976            answers.append({"text": para, "type": "paragraph", "length": "medium"})
1977
1978        return answers
1979
1980    def _translate_question(self, question: str, lang: str) -> str:
1981        translations = {

1985                "relate to": "se relaciona com",
1986                "What is the role of": "Qual é o papel de",

1988                "in the context of": "no contexto de",

1990            },
1991            "es": {
1992                "What is": "Qué es",
1993                "How does": "Cómo",
1994                "relate to": "se relaciona con",
1995                "What is the role of": "Cuál es el papel de",
1996                "Can you explain": "Puedes explicar",
1997                "in the context of": "en el contexto de",
1998                "What is the significance of": "Cuál es la importancia de",
1999            },
2000            "fr": {

2002                "How does": "Comment",
2003                "relate to": "se rapporte à",
2004                "What is the role of": "Quel est le rôle de",
2005                "Can you explain": "Pouvez-vous expliquer",

2019        content_lower = content.lower()

2066                        "graphql",
2067                        "node.js",
2068                    ],
2069                    "fullstack": ["full stack", "full-stack", "mern", "mean"],
2070                },
2071            },

2076                    "data science",
2077                    "data analytics",
2078                    "sql",
2079                    "nosql",
2080                ],
2081                "subtopics": {

2088                        "elasticsearch",
2089                    ],
2090                    "bigdata": ["big data", "hadoop", "spark", "data lake"],
2091                },
2092            },
2093        }
2094
2095        # Tenta encontrar o tópico principal
2096        main_topic = "engenharia de software"
2097        subtopic = "geral"
2098
2099        for topic, data in topics.items():
2100            if any(kw in title_lower or kw in content_lower for kw in data["keywords"]):
2101                main_topic = topic

2138
2139        if client:
2140            futures = [client.submit(self.process_page, page) for page in pages]
2141            processed = 0
2142            total = len(futures)
2143            for fut in tqdm(futures, total=total, desc=progress_desc):
2144                result = fut.result()
2145                processed += 1
2146                if processed % 10 == 0 or processed == total:
2147                    logger.info(f"Distributed progress: {processed}/{total}")
2148                page = pages[processed - 1]
2149                if page in self.pending_pages:
2150                    self.pending_pages.remove(page)
2151                if result:
2152                    self.dataset.append(result)
2153                self._update_progress()
2154            return self.dataset
2155
2156        if not use_queue:
2157            cpu_futures = []
2158            with ThreadPoolExecutor(
2159                max_workers=Config.MAX_THREADS
2160            ) as th_executor, ProcessPoolExecutor(
2161                max_workers=Config.MAX_PROCESSES
2162            ) as pr_executor:
2163                page_futures = {
2164                    th_executor.submit(self.process_page, page, pr_executor): page
2165                    for page in pages
2166                }
2167
2168                processed = 0
2169                total = len(page_futures)
2170                for future in tqdm(
2171                    as_completed(page_futures), total=total, desc=progress_desc
2172                ):
2173                    cpu_future = future.result()
2174                    page = page_futures[future]
2175                    processed += 1
2176                    if page in self.pending_pages:
2177                        self.pending_pages.remove(page)
2178                    if processed % 10 == 0 or processed == total:
2179                        logger.info(f"Thread progress: {processed}/{total}")
2180                    if cpu_future:
2181                        cpu_futures.append(cpu_future)
2182                    self._update_progress()
2183
2184                processed_cpu = 0
2185                total_cpu = len(cpu_futures)
2186                for future in tqdm(
2187                    as_completed(cpu_futures),
2188                    total=total_cpu,
2189                    desc="Processando conteúdo",
2190                ):
2191                    result = future.result()
2192                    processed_cpu += 1
2193                    if processed_cpu % 10 == 0 or processed_cpu == total_cpu:
2194                        logger.info(f"Process progress: {processed_cpu}/{total_cpu}")
2195                    if result:
2196                        self.dataset.append(result)
2197                    self._update_progress()
2198
2199            return self.dataset
2200
2201        # Queue based processing
2202        from task_queue import publish, consume
2203
2204        for page in pages:
2205            publish("scrape_tasks", page)
2206
2207        processed = 0
2208        total = len(pages)
2209        for result in consume("scrape_results"):
2210            if result is None:
2211                continue
2212            processed += 1
2213            for p in list(self.pending_pages):
2214                if p.get("title") == result.get("title") and p.get(
2215                    "lang", p.get("language")
2216                ) == result.get("language"):
2217                    self.pending_pages.remove(p)
2218                    break
2219            self.dataset.append(result)
2220            self._update_progress()
2221            if processed % 10 == 0 or processed == total:
2222                logger.info(f"Queue progress: {processed}/{total}")
2223            if processed == total:
2224                break
2225
2226        return self.dataset

2229        self, pages: List[dict], progress_desc: str = "Processando páginas"
2230    ) -> List[dict]:

2237        cpu_futures = []

2239            tasks = [self.process_page_async(page, pr_executor) for page in pages]
2240
2241            processed = 0

2245            ):

2251                    logger.info(f"Async progress: {processed}/{total}")

2255
2256            processed_cpu = 0
2257            total_cpu = len(cpu_futures)

2260            ):

2288    def save_dataset(self, format: str = "all", output_dir: str = Config.OUTPUT_DIR):
2289        os.makedirs(output_dir, exist_ok=True)
2290
2291        if not self.dataset:
2292            logger.warning("Nenhum dado para salvar")
2293            return
2294
2295        # Balance records by quality before further processing
2296        try:
2297            self.dataset = balance_quality(self.dataset)
2298        except Exception:
2299            pass
2300
2301        for rec in self.dataset:
2302            if "content" in rec:
2303                rec["content"] = dq.strip_credentials(rec["content"])
2304
2305        # Remove near-duplicates based on Simhash
2306        try:
2307            self.dataset, rem_sim = dq.deduplicate_by_simhash(self.dataset)
2308            self.duplicates_removed += rem_sim
2309        except Exception as e:  # pragma: no cover - library issues
2310            logger.error(f"Erro na deduplicação Simhash: {e}")
2311
2312        try:
2313            plag = dq.detect_code_plagiarism(self.dataset)
2314            if plag:
2315                logger.warning(f"Registros plagiados removidos: {len(plag)}")
2316                self.dataset = [r for r in self.dataset if r not in plag]
2317                self.invalid_records += len(plag)
2318        except Exception as e:  # pragma: no cover - library issues
2319            logger.error(f"Erro na verificação de plágio: {e}")
2320
2321        # Validação dos registros antes de salvar
2322        validated_data = []
2323        for item in self.dataset:
2324            valid = True
2325
2326            # Checa se embeddings contêm apenas números finitos
2327            if not np.all(np.isfinite(item.get("content_embedding", []))):
2328                logger.warning(
2329                    f"content_embedding inválido para {item.get('id', 'desconhecido')}"
2330                )
2331                valid = False
2332
2333            if not np.all(np.isfinite(item.get("summary_embedding", []))):
2334                logger.warning(
2335                    f"summary_embedding inválido para {item.get('id', 'desconhecido')}"
2336                )
2337                valid = False
2338
2339            # Checa presença de perguntas e respostas
2340            if not item.get("questions"):
2341                logger.warning(
2342                    f"Registro {item.get('id', 'desconhecido')} sem perguntas"
2343                )
2344                valid = False
2345
2346            if not item.get("answers"):
2347                logger.warning(
2348                    f"Registro {item.get('id', 'desconhecido')} sem respostas"
2349                )
2350                valid = False
2351
2352            if "relations" not in item:
2353                logger.warning(
2354                    f"Registro {item.get('id', 'desconhecido')} sem relações"
2355                )
2356                valid = False
2357
2358            # Verifica tamanho do resumo
2359            summary_text = item.get("summary", "")
2360            if len(summary_text) < Config.MIN_TEXT_LENGTH:
2361                logger.warning(
2362                    f"Resumo muito curto para {item.get('id', 'desconhecido')}"
2363                )
2364                valid = False
2365
2366            if valid:
2367                validated_data.append(item)
2368
2369        # Quality metrics
2370        try:
2371            metrics.dataset_completeness.set(
2372                len(validated_data) / len(self.dataset) if self.dataset else 0.0
2373            )
2374            topics = {i.get("topic") for i in validated_data if i.get("topic")}
2375            metrics.dataset_topic_diversity.set(
2376                len(topics) / len(validated_data) if validated_data else 0.0
2377            )
2378        except Exception:  # pragma: no cover - metrics failures
2379            pass
2380
2381        if not validated_data:
2382            logger.warning("Nenhum registro válido para salvar")
2383            return
2384
2385        # Ordena por idioma e tópico
2386        sorted_data = sorted(validated_data, key=lambda x: (x["language"], x["topic"]))
2387
2388        backend = storage.get_backend(Config.STORAGE_BACKEND, output_dir)
2389        backend.save_dataset(sorted_data, format)
2390        logger.info(f"Dataset salvo usando backend {Config.STORAGE_BACKEND}")
2391
2392        if format == "qa":
2393            save_qa_dataset(sorted_data, Path(output_dir) / "qa_pairs.json")
2394        if format == "text":
2395            save_text_corpus(sorted_data, Path(output_dir) / "text_corpus")
2396
2397        if format in ["all", "hf", "tfrecord"]:
2398            try:
2399                hf_dataset = Dataset.from_list(sorted_data)
2400                hf_dataset.save_to_disk(os.path.join(output_dir, "huggingface"))
2401                logger.info(
2402                    f"Dataset salvo para HuggingFace: {os.path.join(output_dir, 'huggingface')}"
2403                )
2404            except Exception as e:
2405                logger.error(f"Erro ao salvar dataset HuggingFace: {e}")
2406
2407        # Write metadata about the dataset
2408        try:
2409            sources = {
2410                item.get("metadata", {}).get("source", "unknown")
2411                for item in sorted_data
2412            }
2413            info = {
2414                "source": list(sources)[0] if len(sources) == 1 else sorted(sources),
2415                "collection_date": datetime.utcnow().date().isoformat(),
2416                "license": "CC BY-SA 4.0",
2417            }
2418            with open(
2419                os.path.join(output_dir, "dataset_info.json"), "w", encoding="utf-8"
2420            ) as f:
2421                json.dump(info, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
2422        except Exception as e:  # pragma: no cover - unexpected I/O errors
2423            logger.error(f"Erro ao salvar dataset_info.json: {e}")

def process_page( self, page_info: dict, proc_executor: Optional[concurrent.futures.process.ProcessPoolExecutor] = None) -> Optional[object]: 
1658    def process_page(
1659        self, page_info: dict, proc_executor: Optional[ProcessPoolExecutor] = None
1660    ) -> Optional[object]:
1661        start_time = time.perf_counter()
1662        try:
1663            wiki = WikipediaAdvanced(page_info["lang"])
1664            page = wiki.fetch_page(page_info["title"])
1665
1666            if not page or not page.exists():
1667                return None
1668
1669            # Extrai e limpa o texto
1670            raw_text = clean_text(page.text)
1671            clean_content = advanced_clean_text(
1672                raw_text,
1673                page_info["lang"],
1674                remove_stopwords=Config.REMOVE_STOPWORDS,
1675            )
1676
1677            if len(clean_content) < Config.MIN_TEXT_LENGTH:
1678                return None
1679
1680            if proc_executor:
1681                images = extract_images(getattr(page, "_html", ""))
1682                revisions = None
1683                if self.include_revisions:
1684                    revisions = wiki.get_revision_history(
1685                        page_info["title"], self.rev_limit
1686                    )
1687                return proc_executor.submit(
1688                    cpu_process_page,
1689                    page_info["title"],
1690                    clean_content,
1691                    page_info["lang"],
1692                    page_info.get("category", ""),
1693                    images,
1694                    revisions,
1695                    self.rev_limit,
1696                )
1697
1698            # Sumariza o conteúdo
1699            summary = summarize_text(clean_content, page_info["lang"])
1700
1701            # Gera QA pairs avançadas
1702            qa_data = self.generate_qa_pairs(
1703                title=page_info["title"],
1704                content=clean_content,
1705                summary=summary,
1706                lang=page_info["lang"],
1707                category=page_info.get("category", ""),
1708            )
1709            qa_data["entities"] = extract_entities(clean_content)
1710            images = extract_images(getattr(page, "_html", ""))
1711            qa_data["images"] = images
1712            if self.include_revisions:
1713                qa_data.setdefault("metadata", {})["revisions"] = (
1714                    wiki.get_revision_history(page_info["title"], self.rev_limit)
1715                )
1716            metrics.scrape_success.inc()
1717            metrics.pages_scraped_total.inc()
1718            return qa_data
1719        except Exception as e:
1720            metrics.scrape_error.inc()
1721            logger.error(f"Erro ao processar página {page_info.get('title', '')}: {e}")
1722            return None
1723        finally:
1724            metrics.page_processing_seconds.observe(time.perf_counter() - start_time)
