def generate_qa_pairs( self, title: str, content: str, summary: str, lang: str, category: str, extra_metadata: dict | None = None) -> dict: 
1732    def generate_qa_pairs(
1733        self,
1734        title: str,

1736        summary: str,
1737        lang: str,

1741        raw_code = content
1742        code_lang = detect_programming_language(content)
1743        complexities = {}
1744        docstring = ""
1745        signature = ""
1746        problems: list[str] = []
1747        fixed_version = content
1748        if code_lang != "unknown":
1749            signature = parse_function_signature(content)
1750            try:
1751                tree = ast.parse(content)
1752                func = next(
1753                    (
1754                        n
1755                        for n in tree.body
1756                        if isinstance(n, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef))
1757                    ),
1758                    None,
1759                )
1760                if func:

1763                        docstring = docstring_to_google(ds)

1765                pass

1767            complexities = get_functions_complexity(content, code_lang)

1770                if max(complexities.values()) < self.min_complexity:
1771                    return {}
1772            if self.max_complexity is not None and complexities:
1773                if max(complexities.values()) > self.max_complexity:
1774                    return {}
1775        else:
1776            problems, fixed_version = scan_code(content)
1777
1778        # Extrai keywords para gerar perguntas variadas
1779        keywords = extract_keywords(content, lang)
1780
1781        tags = self._extract_tags(keywords, extra_metadata)
1782
1783        # Gera múltiplas perguntas baseadas no conteúdo
1784        questions = self._generate_questions(title, content, lang, keywords)
1785
1786        # Gera respostas completas
1787        answers = self._generate_answers(content, summary, lang)
1788
1789        # Relações semânticas básicas
1790        relations = extract_relations(content, lang)
1791        relations_regex = extract_relations_regex(content)
1792        relations.extend(r for r in relations_regex if r not in relations)
1793
1794        # Cria embeddings para busca semântica
1795        content_embedding = self.embedding_model.encode(
1796            content, show_progress_bar=False
1797        )
1798        summary_embedding = self.embedding_model.encode(
1799            summary, show_progress_bar=False
1800        )
1801
1802        # Classificação avançada de tópicos
1803        topic, subtopic = self._classify_topic(title, content, lang)
1804
1805        record = {
1806            "id": hashlib.md5(f"{title}_{lang}".encode("utf-8")).hexdigest(),
1807            "title": title,
1808            "language": lang,
1809            "category": category,
1810            "topic": topic,
1811            "subtopic": subtopic,
1812            "keywords": keywords,
1813            "tags": tags,
1814            "content": content,
1815            "raw_code": raw_code if code_lang != "unknown" else "",
1816            "summary": summary,
1817            "context": summary,
1818            "problems": problems,
1819            "fixed_version": fixed_version,
1820            "lessons": extra_metadata.get("lessons", "") if extra_metadata else "",
1821            "origin_metrics": (
1822                extra_metadata.get("origin_metrics", {}) if extra_metadata else {}
1823            ),
1824            "challenge": (extra_metadata.get("challenge") if extra_metadata else None)
1825            or generate_challenge_prompt(problems),
1826            "content_embedding": content_embedding.tolist(),
1827            "summary_embedding": summary_embedding.tolist(),
1828            "quality_score": (
1829                extra_metadata.get("quality_score", 0.0) if extra_metadata else 0.0
1830            ),
1831            "quality": None,
1832            "reason": "",
1833            "questions": questions,
1834            "answers": answers,
1835            "relations": relations,
1836            "tests": extra_metadata.get("tests", []) if extra_metadata else [],
1837            "docstring": docstring,
1838            "created_at": datetime.utcnow().isoformat(),
1839            "metadata": {
1840                "length": len(content),
1841                "source": "wikipedia",
1842                "source_url": f"{get_base_url(lang)}/wiki/{title.replace(' ', '_')}",
1843            },
1844        }
1845
1846        # Determine quality classification when possible
1847        if extra_metadata:
1848            if any(
1849                k in extra_metadata for k in ["stars", "stargazers_count", "repository"]
1850            ):
1851                q, r = classify_github_repo(extra_metadata)
1852                record["quality"], record["reason"] = q, r
1853            elif "score" in extra_metadata:
1854                q, r = classify_stackoverflow_answer(extra_metadata)
1855                record["quality"], record["reason"] = q, r
1856        if record["quality"] is None:
1857            score = record.get("quality_score", 0.0)
1858            if score >= 5:
1859                record["quality"] = "high"
1860            elif score >= 2:
1861                record["quality"] = "medium"
1862            else:
1863                record["quality"] = "low"
1864            record["reason"] = "quality score"
1865        if code_lang != "unknown":
1866            record["metadata"]["code_language"] = code_lang
1867            if complexities:
1868                record["metadata"]["complexities"] = complexities
1869            if docstring:
1870                record["docstring"] = docstring
1871            if signature:
1872                record["signature"] = signature
1873        if extra_metadata:
1874            if "wikidata_id" in extra_metadata:
1875                record["wikidata_id"] = extra_metadata["wikidata_id"]
1876            if "image_url" in extra_metadata:
1877                record["image_url"] = extra_metadata["image_url"]
1878        try:
1879            storage_sqlite.save_to_db(
1880                {"id": record["id"], "metadata": record.get("metadata", {})}
1881            )
1882        except Exception as e:
1883            logger.error(f"Erro ao salvar no SQLite: {e}")
1884        return record

2165                    for page in pages
2166                }
2167
2168                processed = 0

2172                ):

2174                    page = page_futures[future]

2178                    if processed % 10 == 0 or processed == total:

2183
2184                processed_cpu = 0

2190                ):

2200
2201        # Queue based processing
2202        from task_queue import publish, consume
2203
2204        for page in pages:
2205            publish("scrape_tasks", page)
2206
2207        processed = 0
2208        total = len(pages)
2209        for result in consume("scrape_results"):
2210            if result is None:
2211                continue
2212            processed += 1
2213            for p in list(self.pending_pages):
2214                if p.get("title") == result.get("title") and p.get(
2215                    "lang", p.get("language")
2216                ) == result.get("language"):
2217                    self.pending_pages.remove(p)
2218                    break
2219            self.dataset.append(result)
2220            self._update_progress()
2221            if processed % 10 == 0 or processed == total:
2222                logger.info(f"Queue progress: {processed}/{total}")
2223            if processed == total:
2224                break
2225
2226        return self.dataset

def main( langs: Optional[List[str]] = None, categories: Optional[List[str]] = None, fmt: str = 'all', rate_limit_delay: Optional[float] = None, *, start_pages: Optional[List[str]] = None, depth: int = 1, revisions: bool = False, rev_limit: int = 5, client=None):

2441    """Gera o dataset utilizando os parâmetros fornecidos."""
2442    start_time = time.perf_counter()
2443    metrics.start_metrics_server(int(os.environ.get("METRICS_PORT", "8001")))
2444    logger.info("🚀 Iniciando Wikipedia Scraper Ultra Pro Max - GodMode++")
2445
2446    if rate_limit_delay is not None:
2447        Config.RATE_LIMIT_DELAY = rate_limit_delay
2448        rate_limiter.base_min = rate_limit_delay
2449        rate_limiter.base_max = rate_limit_delay
2450        rate_limiter.reset()
2451
2452    languages = langs or Config.LANGUAGES
2453    cats = Config.CATEGORIES
2454    if categories:
2455        normalized = [normalize_category(c) or c for c in categories]
2456        cats = {c: Config.CATEGORIES.get(c, 1.0) for c in normalized}
2457
2458    builder = DatasetBuilder(include_revisions=revisions, rev_limit=rev_limit)
2459
2460    all_pages: List[dict] = []
2461    for lang in languages:
2462        logger.info(f"🌐 Processando idioma: {lang.upper()}")
2463        wiki = WikipediaAdvanced(lang)
2464
2465        for category, weight in cats.items():
2466            logger.info(f"🔍 Buscando na categoria: {category} (peso: {weight})")
2467
2468            pages = wiki.get_category_members(category)
2469            logger.info(f"📄 Páginas encontradas em {category}: {len(pages)}")
2470
2471            for page in pages:
2472                page["weight"] = weight
2473
2474            all_pages.extend(pages)
2475            time.sleep(Config.RATE_LIMIT_DELAY * 2)
2476
2477        if start_pages:
2478            for sp in start_pages:
2479                logger.info(
2480                    f"🕸️ Rastreiando links a partir de: {sp} (profundidade: {depth})"
2481                )
2482                pages = wiki.crawl_links(sp, depth)
2483                logger.info(f"📄 Páginas coletadas de {sp}: {len(pages)}")
2484                all_pages.extend(pages)
2485                time.sleep(Config.RATE_LIMIT_DELAY * 2)
2486
2487    logger.info(f"📚 Total de páginas coletadas: {len(all_pages)}")
2488
2489    builder.build_from_pages(all_pages, "Construindo dataset", client=client)
2490
2491    logger.info("🧠 Aplicando técnicas avançadas de NLP...")
2492    builder.enhance_with_clustering()
2493
2494    # Carrega dados extras de plugins para completar registros
2495    extra_data: List[dict] = []
2496    try:
2497        from plugins import load_plugin
2498
2499        for plugin_name in [
2500            "stackoverflow",
2501            "wikidata",
2502            "infobox_parser",
2503            "table_parser",
2504        ]:
2505            try:
2506                plugin = load_plugin(plugin_name)
2507            except Exception as e:
2508                logger.error(f"Erro ao carregar plugin {plugin_name}: {e}")
2509                continue
2510            for lang in languages:
2511                for category in cats:
2512                    try:
2513                        items = plugin.fetch_items(lang, category)
2514                        for item in items:
2515                            parsed = plugin.parse_item(item)
2516                            if parsed:
2517                                extra_data.append(parsed)
2518                    except Exception as e:  # pragma: no cover - network errors
2519                        logger.error(f"Erro plugin {plugin_name}: {e}")
2520    except Exception:
2521        pass
2522
2523    # Deduplicação e validação de qualidade
2524    if hasattr(builder, "dataset"):
2525        data, rem_hash = dq.deduplicate_by_hash(getattr(builder, "dataset", []))
2526        data, rem_emb = dq.deduplicate_by_embedding(data)
2527        data = dq.complete_missing_fields(data, extra_data)
2528        data, invalid = dq.validate_semantics(data)
2529
2530        builder.duplicates_removed = rem_hash + rem_emb
2531        builder.invalid_records = invalid
2532        builder.dataset = data
2533        if hasattr(builder, "_update_progress"):
2534            builder._update_progress()
2535
2536    logger.info("💾 Salvando dataset completo...")
2537    builder.save_dataset(format=fmt)
2538
2539    logger.info("✅ Dataset finalizado com sucesso!")
2540    logger.info(f"📊 Estatísticas de cache: {cache.stats()}")
2541    metrics.scrape_session_seconds.observe(time.perf_counter() - start_time)
